              - name: should return empty when EVP catalog has no entry and no other source provides CEFR
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R011
              - name: should return NLP CEFR hint when EVP catalog has no entry for the lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R010
              - name: should prefer EVP level over NLP CEFR hint when EVP catalog also contains the lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R010
            implements:
              - LemmaCefrLevelResolver
          - name: LemmaCountAnalyzer
            requiresInject:
              - name: contentWordFilter
                type: ContentWordFilter
                description: Aplica el filtro POS content-word del universo (R001).
              - name: lemmaCefrLevelResolver
                type: LemmaCefrLevelResolver
                description: Asigna CEFR al lema con la cadena R009 -> R010 -> R011.
              - name: lemmaCountConfig
                type: LemmaCountConfig
                description: Provee el umbral N usado en el score (R006, R007, R008, R016).
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: should count VERB lemma when content-word filter accepts it
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R001
              - name: should exclude DET token from lemma count when content-word filter rejects it
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R001
              - name: should exclude PROPN token from lemma count when content-word filter rejects it
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R001
              - name: should count run-as-VERB and run-as-NOUN as two distinct lemmas with independent counts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R002
              - name: should count ran-running-runs as three appearances of the same VERB lemma run after lemmatization
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R002
              - name: should not report lemmas absent from the course in the analysis result
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R003
              - name: should count a lemma once when it appears multiple times in the same quiz sentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R004
              - name: should count a lemma N times when it appears in N distinct quiz sentences
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R004
              - name: should accumulate count of an A1 lemma across quizzes from A1 A2 and B1 milestones
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R005
              - name: should compute lemma score as count divided by N when count is below N
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R006
              - name: should cap lemma score at 1.0 when count equals or exceeds N
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R006
              - name: should compute level score as simple average of its lemma scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R012
              - name: should omit a CEFR level from results when no assigned lemma falls into it
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R012
              - name: should compute course score as simple average of level scores regardless of lemma count per level
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R013
              - name: should compute course score using only canonical CEFR levels and ignoring the unassigned group
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R014
              - name: should expose course score in the lemma-count diagnosis attached to the course node
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R015
              - name: should expose empty course score when no canonical CEFR level has assignable score
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R015
              - name: should expose the threshold N used in the lemma-count result
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R016
              - name: should list per-level total of evaluated lemmas in the lemma-count result
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R017
              - name: should list sub-exposed lemmas with score below 1.0 sorted by ascending count for each CEFR level
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R017
              - name: should not list fully exposed lemmas with score 1.0 individually in the per-level detail
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R017
              - name: should list unassigned lemmas with their count in the lemma-count result
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R018
              - name: should return lemma-count as analyzer name
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R019
            implements:
              - ContentAnalyzer
  - name: course-domain
    description: >-
      Domain module for course structure. Contains entity models representing the 5-level hierarchy (Course > ROOT >
      Milestone > Topic > Knowledge > QuizTemplate), ports for persistence and validation, and domain exceptions. All
      models are Java records with defensive copying. This module has no infrastructure dependencies.
    models:
      - name: NodeKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: ROOT
          - name: MILESTONE
          - name: TOPIC
          - name: KNOWLEDGE
      - name: SentencePartKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: TEXT
          - name: CLOZE
      - name: CourseEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: title
            type: String
            description: Course name, e.g. english-course
          - name: knowledgeIds
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered list of all knowledge IDs in the course (R002)
          - name: root
            type: RootNodeEntity
            description: Explicit ROOT node (R001)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
      - name: RootNodeEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Always root
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always ROOT
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Always empty string
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered milestone IDs defining milestone order (R002/R013)
          - name: milestones
            type: List<MilestoneEntity>
            description: Resolved milestone entities in order
      - name: MilestoneEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always MILESTONE
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. A1, B2
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the ROOT node id (R008)
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered topic IDs defining topic order (R002/R013)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within course, 1-based, derived from ROOT children (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: topics
            type: List<TopicEntity>
            description: Resolved topic entities in order
      - name: TopicEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always TOPIC
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. Present Simple
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the parent milestone id (R008)
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Always null in current data, preserved for idempotency (R010)
          - name: ruleIds
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered knowledge IDs defining knowledge order (R002/R013)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within milestone, 1-based, derived from milestone children (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: knowledges
            type: List<KnowledgeEntity>
            description: Resolved knowledge entities in order
      - name: KnowledgeEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always KNOWLEDGE
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. Affirmative sentences in the present simple
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the parent topic id (R008)
          - name: isRule
            type: boolean
            description: Always true in current data
          - name: instructions
            type: String
            description: Exercise instructions in Spanish, may be null in exceptional cases (R009)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within topic, 1-based, derived from topic ruleIds (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: quizTemplates
            type: List<QuizTemplateEntity>
            description: Associated quiz templates, at least 1 required (R004)
      - name: QuizTemplateEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: Plain string ObjectId (R011)
          - name: oidId
            type: String
            description: Same value as id, serialized as $oid wrapper in JSON (R011)
          - name: kind
            type: String
            description: Quiz type, currently always CLOZE
          - name: knowledgeId
            type: String
            description: References parent knowledge id (R008)
          - name: title
            type: String
            description: Quiz title, usually matches knowledge label
          - name: instructions
            type: String
            description: Instructions in Spanish, may be empty
          - name: translation
            type: String
            description: Spanish translation of the sentence
          - name: theoryId
            type: String
            description: Theory reference in format milestone.number.theory_name
          - name: topicName
            type: String
            description: Redundant topic label
          - name: form
            type: FormEntity
            description: Exercise form structure
          - name: difficulty
            type: double
            description: "Difficulty level, currently always 0.0 (R012: stored as $numberDouble)"
          - name: retries
            type: double
            description: "Allowed retries, currently always 0.0 (R012: stored as $numberDouble)"
          - name: noScoreRetries
            type: double
            description: "No-score retries, currently always 0.0 (R012: stored as $numberDouble)"
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Auxiliary code, currently always empty
          - name: audioUrl
            type: String
            description: Exercise audio URL, currently always empty
          - name: imageUrl
            type: String
            description: Exercise image URL, currently always empty
          - name: answerAudioUrl
            type: String
            description: Answer audio reference in format Milestone.section.subsection.number
          - name: answerImageUrl
            type: String
            description: Answer image URL, currently always empty
          - name: miniTheory
            type: String
            description: Inline brief theory, currently always empty
          - name: successMessage
            type: String
            description: Success message, currently always empty
          - name: sentences
            type: List<String>
            description: >-
              Lista de oraciones planas asociadas al template, pre-computada y persistida en la fuente de datos
              (F-DBSENT-R001). Se propaga sin modificacion a AuditableQuiz.sentences durante el mapping del audit
              (F-DBSENT-R002). El indice 0 es la oracion canonica consumida por los analyzers actuales; mas elementos
              quedan disponibles para analisis multi-variante futuro.
      - name: FormEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: kind
            type: String
            description: Form type, currently always CLOZE
          - name: incidence
            type: double
            description: "Weight/frequency, currently always 1.0 (R012: stored as $numberDouble)"
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Form label, currently always empty
          - name: name
            type: String
            description: Form name, currently always empty
          - name: sentenceParts
            type: List<SentencePartEntity>
            description: Ordered sentence parts composing the exercise (R002)
      - name: SentencePartEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: kind
            type: SentencePartKind
            description: TEXT for fixed text, CLOZE for fill-in-the-blank
          - name: text
            type: String
            description: Visible text for TEXT parts, empty for CLOZE
          - name: options
            type: List<String>
            description: Answer options for CLOZE parts, null for TEXT parts
      - name: CourseValidationException
        type: exception
        fields:
          - name: path
            type: String
          - name: detail
            type: String
        message: "Error al cargar el curso desde '%s': %s. La carga fue abortada."
        extends: RuntimeException
    interfaces:
      - name: CourseRepository
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "load(Path path): CourseEntity"
          - signature: "save(CourseEntity course, Path path): void"
      - name: CourseValidator
        stereotype: service
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "validate(CourseEntity course): void"
    scope: internal
    packages:
      - name: quizsentence
        description: >-
          Public contract of the quizSentence DSL. Exposes the converter service and the domain exceptions raised when
          the DSL grammar or the sentenceParts convention is violated. The conversion engine itself is hidden in the
          sibling 'quizsentenceengine' internal package (Public Port, Hidden Adapter).
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: QuizSentenceSerializationException
            type: exception
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: String
                description: Human-readable cause (R013, R024).
              - name: position
                type: String
                description: Index of the offending sentencePart or 'n/a'.
            message: "No es posible serializar a quizSentence: %s (posicion %s)"
            extends: RuntimeException
          - name: QuizSentenceParseException
            type: exception
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: String
                description: Human-readable cause (R016, R024).
              - name: position
                type: int
                description: Character offset in the input where the grammar violation was detected.
            message: "No es posible parsear el quizSentence: %s (posicion %d)"
            extends: RuntimeException
        interfaces:
          - name: QuizSentenceConverter
            stereotype: service
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "serialize(FormEntity form): String"
              - signature: "parse(String quizSentence): FormEntity"
              - signature: "toPlainSentences(FormEntity form): List<String>"
            visibility: public
      - name: quizsentenceengine
        description: >-
          Internal engine implementing the quizSentence DSL conversions. The public class DefaultQuizSentenceConverter
          is instantiated once by the composition root (audit-cli bootstrap); all collaborators (QuizSentenceSerializer,
          QuizSentenceParser, PlainSentenceDeriver, WhitespaceNormalizer) stay package-private so external modules
          cannot bypass the port.
        visibility: internal
        implementations:
          - name: DefaultQuizSentenceConverter
            requiresInject:
              - name: serializer
                type: QuizSentenceSerializer
              - name: parser
                type: QuizSentenceParser
              - name: plainDeriver
                type: PlainSentenceDeriver
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: should treat multi-entry options and pipe-splits as equivalent variants of the same answer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R001
              - name: should treat the pipe character as separator of equivalent variants inside an options entry
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R002
              - name: should fail atomically when a TEXT part has options populated
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R003
              - name: should fail atomically when a CLOZE part has null or empty options
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R004
              - name: should reject an underscore run of length other than four as a blank
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R005
              - name: should reject a blank that is not followed by an answer block in brackets
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R006
              - name: should recognize parenthesized segments as pedagogical hints inside plain-text positions
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R007
              - name: should reject a quizSentence that does not alternate text and blank+block
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R008
              - name: should fail explicitly when reserved characters appear unescaped in TEXT content
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R009
              - name: should emit a single canonical space between text and DSL markers on serialize
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R010
              - name: should tolerate runs of whitespace on parse and normalize them
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R010
              - name: should serialize each TEXT preserving its hints with canonical whitespace
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R011
              - name: should serialize each CLOZE as four underscores followed by bracketed pipe-joined variants
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R012
              - name: should fail atomically when serializing an invalid FormEntity without producing partial output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R013
              - name: should reconstruct alternating TEXT and CLOZE parts by scanning blank+block occurrences
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R014
              - name: should preserve hints inside the reconstructed TEXT text field and not extract them to the model
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R015
              - name: should fail atomically when parsing a malformed quizSentence without producing partial output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R016
              - name: should return a list with one plain sentence per equivalent variant of the answer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R017
              - name: should place the first sub-variant of the first options entry at index 0 as the canonical variant
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R018
              - name: should strip pedagogical hints from every emitted plain sentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R019
              - name: should normalize whitespace in every emitted plain sentence after hint stripping
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R019
              - name: >-
                  should produce the same plain sentences list whether derived directly from sentenceParts or via
                  quizSentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R020
              - name: should fail atomically when toPlainSentences is called on an invalid FormEntity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R024
              - name: >-
                  should preserve semantics on round-trip sentenceParts to quizSentence to sentenceParts under
                  whitespace-normalized equivalence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R021
              - name: >-
                  should preserve the quizSentence string on round-trip through sentenceParts under
                  whitespace-normalized equivalence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R022
              - name: should expose only the three forward conversions and no inverse reconstruction from a plain sentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R023
              - name: should round-trip every real CLOZE in db english-course quizzes json fixtures without error
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R028
              - name: should be consumable as a public course-domain service from another module
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R025
              - name: >-
                  should keep toPlainSentences exposed as a public converter operation that derives the same canonical
                  list from a FormEntity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DBSENT
                  rule: F-DBSENT-R003
            implements:
              - QuizSentenceConverter
          - name: QuizSentenceSerializer
          - name: QuizSentenceParser
          - name: PlainSentenceDeriver
            requiresInject:
              - name: whitespaceNormalizer
                type: WhitespaceNormalizer
                description: >-
                  Helper de normalizacion de whitespace (collapse runs, trim) usado al final de buildSentenceFromParts
                  para cumplir R019 sobre la oracion derivada.
          - name: WhitespaceNormalizer
  - name: refiner-domain
    description: Refinement engine
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
    models:
      - name: DiagnosisKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: SENTENCE_LENGTH
          - name: LEMMA_ABSENCE
          - name: COCA_BUCKETS
          - name: LEMMA_RECURRENCE
          - name: KNOWLEDGE_TITLE_LENGTH
          - name: KNOWLEDGE_INSTRUCTIONS_LENGTH
      - name: RefinementTaskStatus
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: PENDING
          - name: COMPLETED
          - name: SKIPPED
      - name: RefinementTask
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: Unique task identifier
          - name: nodeTarget
            type: AuditTarget
            description: The hierarchy level of the node (QUIZ, KNOWLEDGE, TOPIC, MILESTONE, COURSE)
          - name: nodeId
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the target entity
          - name: nodeLabel
            type: String
            description: Human-readable label for display
          - name: diagnosisKind
            type: DiagnosisKind
            description: Which analyzer flagged the problem
          - name: priority
            type: int
            description: Priority rank (1 = highest)
          - name: status
            type: RefinementTaskStatus
            description: Current status
      - name: RefinementPlan
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: Unique plan identifier
          - name: sourceAuditId
            type: String
            description: ID of the AuditReport this plan was derived from
          - name: createdAt
            type: Instant
            description: When this plan was created
          - name: tasks
            type: List<RefinementTask>
            description: Prioritized list of refinement tasks
      - name: SuggestedLemma
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: lemma
            type: String
          - name: pos
            type: String
          - name: reason
            type: String
          - name: cocaRank
            type: Integer
          - name: lemmaCount
            type: Integer
            description: Observed lemma-count signal for the target level when available; null means unavailable.
          - name: lemmaCountThreshold
            type: Integer
            description: Minimum lemma-count threshold used to decide underexposure when available; null means unavailable.
          - name: isUnderexposed
            type: Boolean
            description: >-
              Whether lemmaCount is below lemmaCountThreshold when lemma-count data is available; null means
              unavailable.
      - name: SentenceLengthCorrectionContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: taskId
            type: String
          - name: sentence
            type: String
          - name: translation
            type: String
          - name: knowledgeTitle
            type: String
          - name: knowledgeInstructions
            type: String
          - name: topicLabel
            type: String
          - name: cefrLevel
            type: CefrLevel
          - name: tokenCount
            type: int
          - name: targetMin
            type: int
          - name: targetMax
            type: int
          - name: delta
            type: int
          - name: suggestedLemmas
            type: List<SuggestedLemma>
        implements:
          - CorrectionContext
      - name: MisplacedLemmaContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: lemma
            type: String
            description: Base form of the misplaced word
          - name: pos
            type: String
            description: Part of speech (e.g., VERB, NOUN)
          - name: expectedLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level where this word belongs per EVP (always higher than quizLevel)
          - name: quizLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level of the quiz where the word was found
          - name: cocaRank
            type: Integer
            description: COCA frequency ranking (nullable)
      - name: LemmaAbsenceCorrectionContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: taskId
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the refinement task
          - name: sentence
            type: String
            description: Current quiz sentence as plain text
          - name: translation
            type: String
            description: Spanish translation of the sentence
          - name: knowledgeTitle
            type: String
            description: Title of the parent knowledge
          - name: knowledgeInstructions
            type: String
            description: Instructions of the exercise
          - name: topicLabel
            type: String
            description: Label of the parent topic
          - name: cefrLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level determined by milestone ancestor
          - name: misplacedLemmas
            type: List<MisplacedLemmaContext>
            description: Words in the quiz whose expected CEFR level is higher than the quiz level
          - name: suggestedLemmas
            type: List<SuggestedLemma>
            description: Absent lemmas from the level that could serve as replacements (reuses existing SuggestedLemma model)
          - name: quizSentence
            type: String
            description: >-
              FEAT-QSENT DSL of the original quiz (R001). Copied verbatim from AuditableQuiz.quizSentence by
              LemmaAbsenceContextResolver; never recomputed in this module. Coexists with `sentence` (plain) per R001 —
              both correspond to the same quiz and the same derivation step (R003). Null when the upstream AuditableQuiz
              was built before FEAT-QSENT was shipped.
          - name: tokenCount
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Cantidad actual de tokens en la oracion del quiz, copiada de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.tokenCount sobre el
              mismo nodo quiz (F-RCLALEN-R001, F-RCLALEN-R003). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico de longitud
              disponible (F-RCLALEN-R004); reusa nombre y semantica de F-RCSL-R001.
          - name: targetMin
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Minimo de tokens esperados para el nivel CEFR del quiz, copiado de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.targetMin
              (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004).
          - name: targetMax
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Maximo de tokens esperados para el nivel CEFR del quiz, copiado de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.targetMax
              (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004).
          - name: delta
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Desviacion respecto al rango: 0 si esta dentro, positivo si excede el maximo, negativo si esta por debajo
              del minimo (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004). Misma convencion de
              signo que F-RCSL-R001.
          - name: lengthDirection
            type: LengthDirection
            description: >
              Direccion accionable derivada del signo de delta por el resolver (F-RCLALEN-R002). Cuando no hay
              SentenceLengthDiagnosis se establece a UNKNOWN (F-RCLALEN-R004), nunca null. Pre-calculado del lado del
              sistema para que el prompt LLM sea deterministico y la salida CLI tenga una etiqueta legible para humanos.
        implements:
          - CorrectionContext
      - name: LengthDirection
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: SHORTEN
            description: La oracion excede el rango (delta > 0); el LLM debe acortarla mientras reemplaza vocabulario.
          - name: LENGTHEN
            description: >-
              La oracion esta por debajo del rango (delta < 0); el LLM tiene margen para incorporar mas vocabulario
              sugerido.
          - name: KEEP_SAME
            description: La oracion esta dentro del rango (delta == 0); el LLM debe mantener una longitud similar al reemplazar.
          - name: UNKNOWN
            description: >-
              No hay SentenceLengthDiagnosis disponible para el nodo quiz (F-RCLALEN-R004); el LLM solo se gua por las
              reglas existentes de FEAT-RCLA.
        visibility: public
        glossarySuggestions:
          - name: Length Direction
            technicalName: LengthDirection
            kind: value-object-candidate
            basedOn: refiner-domain/LengthDirection
            rationale: >
              Etiqueta accionable y enumerable que el contexto de correccion expone al LLM. Si surge la necesidad de
              razonarla en otros contextos (revision, refinement, reportes), promover a termino canonico del glosario.

  - name: audit-cli
    description: CLI entry point
    dependsOn:
      - audit-application
      - audit-domain
      - course-domain
      - course-infrastructure
      - nlp-infrastructure
      - vocabulary-infrastructure
      - audit-infrastructure
      - refiner-domain
      - revision-domain
      - revision-infrastructure
    models:
      - name: GetTasksFilter
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: planId
            type: Optional<String>
            description: Restrict to tasks belonging to this plan id; if empty, the most recent plan is used (R012)
          - name: status
            type: Optional<String>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose status matches this value, case-insensitive (pending/completed/skipped) — R008
          - name: sortByPriority
            type: boolean
            description: If true, order results by ascending task priority — R008
          - name: limit
            type: Optional<Integer>
            description: Cap the result count after filter+sort; 0 yields empty (R009); negative is rejected
          - name: target
            type: Optional<AuditTarget>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose nodeTarget matches this AuditTarget enum value; absent = no filter (R008)
          - name: diagnosisKind
            type: Optional<DiagnosisKind>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose diagnosisKind matches this DiagnosisKind enum value; absent = no filter (R008)
      - name: LagenMode
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: LLM
            description: Default. The CLI wires the LangChain4j-backed generator from revision-infrastructure (F-LAGEN-R013).
          - name: CANNED
            description: >-
              Opt-in offline mode. The CLI wires CannedLemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator from
              revision-domain.lemmaabsence with fixed quizSentence/translation. DOUBT-CANNED-MODE-AVAILABILITY -> Option
              B (kept as opt-in, never default).
        visibility: public
      - name: PlanStorageMode
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: DISK
            description: >-
              Persistent path: el plan se guarda via RefinementPlanStore en .content-audit/refinement-plans/.
              Comportamiento previo a F-PLANEF, sigue siendo el default cuando el operador no pasa --storage.
          - name: EPHEMERAL
            description: >-
              Modo efimero (F-PLANEF-R001). El comando plan calcula el plan, NO lo persiste, y emite la representacion
              JSON completa por stdout. Mensajes informativos van a stderr.
        visibility: public
      - name: EphemeralRenderOptions
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: withCorrectionContext
            type: boolean
            description: >-
              F-PLANEF-R002: si true, cada task del plan emitido lleva inline su correctionContext (o
              correctionContext=null + correctionContextError si no es construible). Default OFF (DOUBT-CTX-DEFAULT
              opcion A).
        visibility: public

      - name: AnalyzeCommand
        stereotype: port

                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan, cuando render se invoca, entonces el JSON se emite por la salida estandar
                  (stdout) y stderr permanece vacio — R001 invariante 2: el canal del plan es stdout, no stderr
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks no vacias y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=false,
                  cuando render se invoca, entonces el JSON emitido no contiene la clave correctionContext en ninguna
                  task y ni el resolver ni el mapper son invocados — R002 invariante #3: opt-in default OFF preserva
                  R001 y no se cambia silenciosamente
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando render se
                  invoca y el resolver retorna contexto para cada task, entonces cada task del JSON emitido tiene un
                  campo correctionContext igual al mapa producido por CorrectionContextJsonMapper.toJsonMap aplicado al
                  contexto resuelto via resolveWithIndex con el indice construido a partir del AuditReport — R002
                  invariante #1: contexto inline por tarea con la misma estructura/semantica que get task
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan y una unica instancia de CorrectionContextJsonMapper inyectada en GetCmd y en
                  DefaultEphemeralPlanRenderer, cuando ambos comandos serializan el correctionContext de la misma task
                  derivada del mismo AuditReport, entonces el campo correctionContext que emite plan efimero es
                  estructuralmente igual al que emite get task (mismas claves, mismos valores) — R002 invariante #2:
                  equivalencia funcional con get task garantizada por compartir el mapper
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando render se
                  invoca y el resolver retorna Optional.empty para una task (contexto no construible), entonces esa task
                  del JSON emitido tiene correctionContext en null y un campo descriptivo del motivo, con la misma
                  semantica que F-RCLA-R008 define para get task — R002 invariante #4: tareas sin contexto construible
                  llevan correctionContext ausente o nulo + motivo
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks mixtas y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando
                  render se invoca y el resolver retorna contexto para algunas tasks y Optional.empty para otras,
                  entonces el comando retorna codigo 0, el JSON emitido contiene todas las tasks, las tasks resueltas
                  llevan correctionContext con valor y las no resueltas llevan correctionContext en null + motivo — R002
                  invariante #4: el comando no falla globalmente, emite el plan completo con la falla por tarea visible
                  para el cliente
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
            implements:
              - EphemeralPlanRenderer
          - name: DefaultCorrectionContextJsonMapper
            visibility: internal
            implements:
              - CorrectionContextJsonMapper

                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R014
              - name: >-
                  InvalidLagenModeException raised by resolve has a message that identifies the unrecognised mode value
                  declared by the operator (per R014)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R014
            implements:

          - name: DefaultLagenConfigResolver
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  resolve returns a LagenConfig populated from every CONTENT_AUDIT_LAGEN_* env entry when all required
                  keys are present and valid
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  resolve returns LagenConfig with apiKey=null when the apiKey env entry is absent (knob nullable per
                  R008)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  resolve returns LagenConfig with temperature=null when the temperature env entry is absent (factory
                  will substitute LagenDefaults.temperature)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  resolve returns LagenConfig with maxTokens=null when the maxTokens env entry is absent (factory will
                  substitute LagenDefaults.maxTokens)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  resolve returns LagenConfig with timeout=null when the timeout env entry is absent (factory will
                  substitute LagenDefaults.timeout)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  resolve raises InvalidLagenConfigException identifying the temperature env key when its value is not a
                  parseable number (fail-fast per R014)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R014
              - name: >-
                  resolve raises InvalidLagenConfigException identifying the timeout env key when its value is not a
                  positive duration (fail-fast per R014)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN

              - name: >-
                  resolve raises InvalidLagenConfigException identifying the maxTokens env key when its value is not a

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R014
              - name: >-

              - name: >-
                  resolve raises InvalidLagenConfigException identifying the providerName env key when its value is

  - name: nlp-infrastructure
    description: >-
      Infrastructure module for NLP processing. Provides SpaCy-backed tokenization behind a factory, with internal
      caching. Only the factory and configuration model are public; all processing internals are package-private.
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
    models:
      - name: NlpTokenizerConfig
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: pythonScriptPath
            type: String
            description: Path to the SpaCy Python processing script
          - name: cocaDataPath
            type: String
            description: Path to the COCA frequency data file
          - name: timeoutSeconds
            type: int
            description: Maximum seconds to wait for SpaCy process completion
    interfaces:
      - name: NlpTokenizerFactory
        stereotype: factory
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "create(NlpTokenizerConfig config): NlpTokenizer"
    patterns:
      - type: Factory
        implementations:
          - SpacyNlpTokenizerFactory
        suppressed: false
        interface: NlpTokenizerFactory
    packages:
      - name: spacy
        description: >-
          SpaCy-backed NLP tokenization internals. Only the factory is public; all processing classes are
          package-private.
        visibility: public
        implementations:
          - name: SpacyNlpTokenizerFactory
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should invoke the SpaCy-backed pipeline using the pythonScriptPath and cocaDataPath provided in
                  NlpTokenizerConfig (not a hardcoded location) and propagate a clear error citing the missing path when
                  either points to a non-existent or unreadable file
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R021
              - name: >-
                  Given an environment where SpaCy is not available, when the factory creates the tokenizer and an audit
                  runs, then basic-count analyzers complete normally while enriched-token-requiring analyzers are
                  reported as omitted in the final audit report
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R030
                  journey: F-NLP-J002
            implements:
              - NlpTokenizerFactory
          - name: SpacyNlpTokenizer
            requiresInject:
              - name: processRunner
                type: SpacyProcessRunner
              - name: resultParser
                type: SpacyResultParser
            visibility: package-private
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should produce every NlpToken with the six mandatory fields text lemma posTag frequencyRank isStop and
                  isPunct populated except frequencyRank which may be null when COCA has no entry
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R001
              - name: >-
                  should never fail when the optional NlpToken fields tag isAlpha and dep are absent confirming they are
                  not required for the tokenizer contract
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R002
              - name: >-
                  should populate the lemma field with the lowercased base form returned by SpaCy so that running yields
                  run was yields be and children yields child
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R003
              - name: >-
                  should populate the posTag field with one of the Universal Dependencies tags (NOUN VERB ADJ ADV PROPN
                  NUM ADP AUX CCONJ DET INTJ PART PRON SCONJ PUNCT SYM SPACE X) for every token produced
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R004
              - name: >-
                  should produce a List<NlpToken> from analyzeTokens replacing the legacy List<String> tokenize
                  representation as the primary tokenizer output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R005
              - name: >-
                  should expose analyzeTokens(String) returning a List<NlpToken> for a single sentence with linguistic
                  enrichment for every word
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R006
              - name: >-
                  should still report a usable token count via the size of the analyzeTokens result without requiring a
                  separate countTokens call so SentenceLengthAnalyzer continues to work
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R007
              - name: >-
                  should not implement any analyzer interface confirming the tokenizer is an infrastructure service that
                  only transforms text into enriched tokens without producing scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R009
              - name: >-
                  should derive the frequencyRank from the COCA entry matched against the token's lemma and not the
                  inflected form so that running running and ran all carry the same rank as run
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R011
              - name: >-
                  should map every Universal Dependencies posTag emitted by SpaCy to its corresponding COCA
                  single-character code (NOUN to n VERB to v ADJ to j ADV to r PRON to p DET to a ADP to i
                  CONJ/CCONJ/SCONJ to c NUM to m PART/PRT to t INTJ to u SYM/PUNCT/SPACE/X to x) when looking up
                  frequency
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R012
              - name: >-
                  should apply the three-tier COCA lookup strategy resolving frequencyRank by exact-word match first
                  then by lemma+pos-code match and finally by lemma-only match before giving up
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R013
              - name: >-
                  should ignore the first 8 metadata lines and the column header line of lemmas_20k_words.txt and parse
                  the TSV body so that lookups use the correct lemRank lemma PoS lemFreq wordFreq and word columns
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R014
              - name: >-
                  should load the COCA frequency data only once during initialization and then resolve every subsequent
                  token lookup against the in-memory index without re-reading the file
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R015
              - name: >-
                  should set the token frequencyRank to the lemRank column of the matched COCA entry not to the wordFreq
                  of the specific inflected form
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R016
              - name: >-
                  should delegate linguistic processing to an external SpaCy-backed pipeline (Python process with
                  en_core_web_sm) producing tokenization lemmatization POS tagging and stop-word/punctuation detection
                  in a single pass
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R017
              - name: >-
                  should perform tokenization lemmatization POS tagging and COCA frequency lookup all within the same
                  SpaCy-backed processing step without splitting them across multiple external calls
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R019
              - name: >-
                  should produce a clear runtime error indicating the missing environment component (Python 3.11+ SpaCy
                  en_core_web_sm or lemmas_20k_words.txt) when the tokenizer is invoked without the required environment
                  installed
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R020
              - name: >-
                  should produce a valid NlpToken with frequencyRank set to null and all other linguistic fields
                  populated when the three-tier COCA lookup finds no entry for the token
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R028
              - name: >-
                  should propagate a descriptive exception (and not return partial or corrupt tokens) when the
                  underlying Python process fails to start exits abnormally or returns invalid JSON output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R029
              - name: >-
                  should continue tokenizing the remaining sentences of a batch and emit a fallback NlpToken (text as-is
                  lemma=lowercased text posTag=X frequencyRank=null isStop=false isPunct=heuristic) when a single token
                  inside SpaCy fails
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R032
            implements:
              - NlpTokenizer
          - name: SpacyProcessRunner
            requiresInject:
              - name: config
                type: NlpTokenizerConfig
            visibility: package-private
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should terminate the SpaCy python process and return no tokens with a timeout error citing the
                  configured value when processing exceeds NlpTokenizerConfig.timeoutSeconds
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R031
          - name: SpacyResultParser
            visibility: package-private
          - name: CachedNlpTokenizer
            requiresInject:
              - name: delegate
                type: NlpTokenizer
            visibility: package-private
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should serve repeated analyzeTokens calls for the same sentence text from an in-memory cache so that
                  the delegate NlpTokenizer is invoked only on the first call
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R023
              - name: >-
                  should treat two sentences differing in any single character (case spacing punctuation) as distinct
                  cache entries triggering a fresh delegate invocation for each variant
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R024
              - name: >-
                  should cache List<NlpToken> produced by analyzeTokens with the same decorator pattern previously used
                  for tokenize String results so cached entries match the enriched signature
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-NLP
                  rule: F-NLP-R026
            implements:
              - NlpTokenizer

  - name: audit-infrastructure
    description: >-
      Filesystem persistence adapters for audit reports, refinement plans, revision artifacts, impact previews and the
      active analysis selection. Hosts the five adapters that the CLI composition root wires into the corresponding
      ports (AuditReportStore, RefinementPlanStore, RevisionArtifactStore, ImpactPreviewStore,
      ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore). The active-analysis-selection adapter writes a single dotfile under .content-audit/
      so cualquier consumidor del CLI lo lee con la misma simetria que los demas stores filesystem.
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
      - refiner-domain
      - revision-domain
    implementations:
      - name: FileSystemAuditReportStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/audits/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main) tipicamente como Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")) o el path del flag --course.
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: should save an AuditReport and load it back with identical content
            _change: delete
        implements:
          - AuditReportStore
      - name: FileSystemRefinementPlanStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/refinement-plans/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main).
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        implements:
          - RefinementPlanStore
      - name: FileSystemRevisionArtifactStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/revisions/<planId>/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main).
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: Given a RevisionArtifact, when save is called, then a file is written under .content-audit/revisions/
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R008
          - name: >-
              Given an artifact for plan P1 and proposal PR1, when save is called, then the file path is
              .content-audit/revisions/P1/PR1.<ext>
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R009
          - name: >-
              Given a persisted artifact, when load is called, then all RevisionProposal fields plus verdict and
              rejectionReason are recoverable
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R010
          - name: >-
              Given artifacts saved under multiple plan directories, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.empty()) is
              called, then it scans subdirectories and returns the matching artifact
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given no artifact matches the id, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.empty()) is called, then it returns
              Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given an artifact saved under plan P1, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.of(P1)) is called, then it takes
              the direct path and returns the artifact
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given no artifact under plan P1 with that id, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.of(P1)) is called, then
              it returns Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given a PENDING_APPROVAL artifact whose taskId matches, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns true
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given only an APPROVED artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given only a REJECTED artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: Given no artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given artifacts saved under multiple plan directories, when list() is called, then it returns all of them
              across all plans
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: Given the revisions directory is empty or missing, when list() is called, then it returns an empty list
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given the store is constructed with a non-default baseDir, when save is called, then the artifact file
              lands under <baseDir>/.content-audit/revisions/<planId>/<proposalId>.* and NOT under
              System.getProperty('user.dir')
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R017
        implements:
          - RevisionArtifactStore
      - name: FileSystemImpactPreviewStore

              provee la composition root (audit-cli.Main).
