  - name: audit-infrastructure
    description: >-
      Filesystem persistence adapters for audit reports, refinement plans, revision artifacts, impact previews and the
      active analysis selection. Hosts the five adapters that the CLI composition root wires into the corresponding
      ports (AuditReportStore, RefinementPlanStore, RevisionArtifactStore, ImpactPreviewStore,
      ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore). The active-analysis-selection adapter writes a single dotfile under .content-audit/
      so cualquier consumidor del CLI lo lee con la misma simetria que los demas stores filesystem.
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
      - refiner-domain
      - revision-domain
    implementations:
      - name: FileSystemAuditReportStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/audits/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main) tipicamente como Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")) o el path del flag --course.
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: should save an AuditReport and load it back with identical content
            _change: delete
        implements:
          - AuditReportStore
      - name: FileSystemRefinementPlanStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/refinement-plans/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main).
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        implements:
          - RefinementPlanStore
      - name: FileSystemRevisionArtifactStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/revisions/<planId>/. Lo provee la composition root
              (audit-cli.Main).
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: Given a RevisionArtifact, when save is called, then a file is written under .content-audit/revisions/
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R008
          - name: >-
              Given an artifact for plan P1 and proposal PR1, when save is called, then the file path is
              .content-audit/revisions/P1/PR1.<ext>
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R009
          - name: >-
              Given a persisted artifact, when load is called, then all RevisionProposal fields plus verdict and
              rejectionReason are recoverable
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVBYP
              rule: F-REVBYP-R010
          - name: >-
              Given artifacts saved under multiple plan directories, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.empty()) is
              called, then it scans subdirectories and returns the matching artifact
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given no artifact matches the id, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.empty()) is called, then it returns
              Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given an artifact saved under plan P1, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.of(P1)) is called, then it takes
              the direct path and returns the artifact
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given no artifact under plan P1 with that id, when findByProposalId(id, Optional.of(P1)) is called, then
              it returns Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given a PENDING_APPROVAL artifact whose taskId matches, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns true
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given only an APPROVED artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given only a REJECTED artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it
              returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: Given no artifact exists for the task, when hasPendingProposalForTask is called, then it returns false
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R009
          - name: >-
              Given artifacts saved under multiple plan directories, when list() is called, then it returns all of them
              across all plans
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: Given the revisions directory is empty or missing, when list() is called, then it returns an empty list
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R002
          - name: >-
              Given the store is constructed with a non-default baseDir, when save is called, then the artifact file
              lands under <baseDir>/.content-audit/revisions/<planId>/<proposalId>.* and NOT under
              System.getProperty('user.dir')
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-REVAPR
              rule: F-REVAPR-R017
        implements:
          - RevisionArtifactStore
      - name: FileSystemImpactPreviewStore
        requiresInject:
          - name: baseDir
            type: Path
            description: >-
              Directorio raiz bajo el cual se resuelve .content-audit/revisions/<planId>/<proposalId>.preview.json. Lo
              provee la composition root (audit-cli.Main).
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: >-
              Dado un ImpactPreview ya persistido bajo un proposalId, cuando save se invoca por segunda vez con otro
              ImpactPreview con el mismo proposalId, entonces findByProposalId retorna el preview persistido
              originalmente y no el nuevo
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-PIPRE
              rule: F-PIPRE-R008
          - name: >-
              Dado un ImpactPreview persistido en disco, cuando findByProposalId se invoca con su proposalId, entonces
              retorna el ImpactPreview con todos sus levelImpacts, availability y unavailability intactos
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-PIPRE
              rule: F-PIPRE-R008
        implements:
          - ImpactPreviewStore
      - name: FileSystemActiveAnalysisSelectionStore
        types:
          - Repository
        visibility: public
        handwrittenTests:
          - name: >-
              Dado un ActiveAnalysisSelection escrito previamente con write, cuando read corre, entonces retorna un
              Optional con esa misma seleccion (auditId y planId)
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-CDIFF
              rule: F-CDIFF-R001
          - name: Dado un store sin seleccion previa (archivo ausente), cuando read corre, entonces retorna Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-CDIFF
              rule: F-CDIFF-R001
          - name: >-
              Dado un store con una seleccion ya escrita, cuando write se invoca con la misma seleccion, entonces el
              archivo no se reescribe (write idempotente y no destructivo a nivel observable)
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-CDIFF
              rule: F-CDIFF-R002
          - name: >-
              Dado un store con una seleccion escrita, cuando clear corre, entonces read posterior retorna
              Optional.empty
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-CDIFF
              rule: F-CDIFF-R001
          - name: >-
              Dado un courseRoot con AuditReports y RefinementPlans persistidos, cuando write y clear se invocan sobre
              el ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore, entonces ningun AuditReport, RefinementPlan, RevisionArtifact ni archivo
              del curso se modifica
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-CDIFF
              rule: F-CDIFF-R002
        implements:
          - ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore
    scope: internal
  - name: revision-domain
    description: >-
      Domain module for the revision phase of the refinement pipeline. Consumes refiner-domain (task and
      CorrectionContext), course-domain (course entities and the CourseRepository port owned by the caller) and
      audit-domain (AuditReport / AuditEngine / ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore for the eager what-if simulation that
      powers the impact preview and the consolidated view). Exposes
      Reviser/RevisionValidator/RevisionArtifactStore/CourseElementLocator/ImpactPreviewStore ports plus the
      RevisionEngineFactory seam, the lemmaabsence proposal-strategy SPI, the impactpreview SPI (FEAT-PIPRE) and the
      consolidatedview SPI (FEAT-CDIFF) — including the dynamic field-diff engine that powers FEAT-CDIFF v3 (recursive
      walker + central role-based exclusion registry + central list-identity registry, all inside the fielddiff
      package). The bypass baseline, the impact-preview internals, the consolidated-view internals and the field-diff
      internals live behind their respective internal packages; external modules only see factories, ports and carrier
      records.
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
      - refiner-domain
      - course-domain
    models:
      - name: RevisionVerdict
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: APPROVED
          - name: REJECTED
          - name: PENDING_APPROVAL
            description: >-
              The validator has deferred the decision to a human operator (R007). The artifact is persisted but the
              course is not written.
      - name: RevisionOutcomeKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: APPROVED_APPLIED
            description: Proposal approved and course rewritten (R011)
          - name: APPROVED_APPLY_FAILED
            description: Proposal approved, artifact persisted, course write failed (R014, DOUBT-ATOMICITY)
          - name: REJECTED
            description: Proposal rejected by validator; course untouched (R012)
          - name: NO_REVISER
            description: No Reviser accepts the DiagnosisKind (R005)
          - name: CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE
            description: CorrectionContext could not be resolved from the audit report
          - name: ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND
            description: Target element (nodeTarget+nodeId) not present in the loaded course
          - name: PENDING_APPROVAL_PERSISTED
            description: Proposal persisted with PENDING_APPROVAL; course untouched (R008)
          - name: ALREADY_PENDING_DECISION
            description: revise rejected because the task already has a pending proposal (R010)
          - name: NO_ACTIVE_STRATEGY
            description: >-
              A LEMMA_ABSENCE task reached the dispatcher but no LemmaAbsenceProposalStrategy was active. No artifact,
              no course write, task unchanged (F-LAPS-R006, F-LAPS-J004).
          - name: STRATEGY_FAILED
            description: >-
              The active strategy could not produce a candidate (empty output, provider down, uninterpretable response)
              or its candidate could not be derived. No artifact, no course write, task unchanged (F-LAPS-R015,
              F-LAPS-R016, F-LAPS-J003).
          - name: OVERRIDE_INVALID
            description: >-
              El correctionContext provisto externamente no respeta el contrato estructural (R003) o no es coherente con
              la tarea persistida (sanity check de nodeId+diagnosisKind, DOUBT-OVERRIDE-COHERENCE). No se persiste
              artefacto, no se modifica curso ni tarea.
          - name: OVERRIDE_NOT_APPLICABLE
            description: >-
              La tarea revisada es de un DiagnosisKind para el cual no existe contrato de correctionContext (R004). El
              override no tiene como afectar al bypass; se rechaza la invocacion sin persistir artefacto.
      - name: CourseElementSnapshot
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: nodeTarget
            type: AuditTarget
            description: QUIZ/KNOWLEDGE/TOPIC/MILESTONE/COURSE
          - name: nodeId
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the targeted node
          - name: quiz
            type: QuizTemplateEntity
            description: Full quiz snapshot when nodeTarget=QUIZ; null otherwise
      - name: RevisionProposal
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: proposalId
            type: String
            description: Unique id, convention <taskId>-<timestamp> (R009)
          - name: taskId
            type: String
            description: Originating RefinementTask id
          - name: planId
            type: String
            description: Owning RefinementPlan id
          - name: sourceAuditId
            type: String
            description: AuditReport that produced the plan
          - name: diagnosisKind
            type: DiagnosisKind
            description: Diagnosis that drove the revision
          - name: nodeTarget
            type: AuditTarget
          - name: nodeId
            type: String
          - name: elementBefore
            type: CourseElementSnapshot
            description: Element state before the revision (R001)
          - name: elementAfter
            type: CourseElementSnapshot
            description: Proposed element state; equals elementBefore in bypass (R002)
          - name: rationale
            type: String
            description: "Human-readable justification; 'bypass: identity revision' in bypass (R004)"
          - name: reviserKind
            type: String
            description: Reviser identifier; 'bypass' in this iteration
          - name: createdAt
            type: Instant
          - name: strategyId
            type: StrategyId
            description: >-
              Identity of the strategy that produced this proposal (F-LAPS-R005); null when produced by the bypass
              reviser for non-LEMMA_ABSENCE diagnostics (FEAT-REVBYP).
      - name: RevisionArtifact
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: proposal
            type: RevisionProposal
          - name: verdict
            type: RevisionVerdict
            description: APPROVED/REJECTED (R006)
          - name: rejectionReason
            type: String
            description: Populated when verdict=REJECTED; null when APPROVED (R010)
          - name: outcome
            type: RevisionOutcomeKind
            description: Final flow outcome including course-write failures (R014)
          - name: decidedAt
            type: Instant
            description: >-
              Timestamp when the verdict transitioned from PENDING_APPROVAL to APPROVED/REJECTED; null while pending or
              for auto-mode artifacts that never passed through PENDING_APPROVAL
          - name: decisionNote
            type: String
            description: >-
              Free-text note attached by the operator on approve/reject (R011 --note, R012 --reason); null if not
              provided
          - name: contextSource
            type: CorrectionContextSource
            description: >-
              Origen del correctionContext consumido por la estrategia (FEAT-REVCTX R002 #3). DERIVED para artefactos
              pre-FEAT-REVCTX o invocaciones sin override; OVERRIDE cuando el cliente provee el contexto via revise
              --correction-context(-file).
          - name: contextOverridePayload
            type: String
            description: >-
              Snapshot crudo del JSON entregado por el cliente como override (DOUBT-OVERRIDE-AUDITABILITY Opcion A).
              Null cuando contextSource=DERIVED. Se persiste literal para que la auditoria del artefacto sea
              reconstruible a posteriori.
      - name: RevisionOutcome
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: kind
            type: RevisionOutcomeKind
          - name: artifact
            type: RevisionArtifact
            description: Persisted artifact; null for pre-proposal aborts
          - name: errorMessage
            type: String
            description: Human-readable message for failure outcomes
      - name: RevisionEngineConfig
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: revisers
            type: Map<DiagnosisKind,Reviser>
            description: >-
              Per-DiagnosisKind Revisers (R003). May be empty; factory adds IdentityReviser as the catch-all fallback
              (R004).
          - name: validator
            type: RevisionValidator
            description: Optional; factory uses AutoApproveValidator when null (R007)
          - name: artifactStore
            type: RevisionArtifactStore
            description: Required; no default (needs filesystem root)
          - name: courseRepository
            type: CourseRepository
            description: Required; caller owns course IO wiring
          - name: elementLocator
            type: CourseElementLocator
            description: Optional; factory uses DefaultCourseElementLocator when null
          - name: refinementPlanStore
            type: RefinementPlanStore
            description: Required; needed to load/save the task
          - name: auditReportStore
            type: AuditReportStore
            description: Required; needed to resolve the CorrectionContext
          - name: contextResolver
            type: CorrectionContextResolver<CorrectionContext>
            description: Required; caller owns the resolver registry
          - name: lemmaAbsenceStrategyRegistry
            type: LemmaAbsenceProposalStrategyRegistry
            description: >-
              Registry of registered LEMMA_ABSENCE strategies. Nullable -> the factory wires an empty registry, in which
              case every LEMMA_ABSENCE task resolves to NO_ACTIVE_STRATEGY (F-LAPS-R006).
          - name: lemmaAbsenceProposalDeriver
            type: LemmaAbsenceProposalDeriver
            description: >-
              Deterministic deriver used when a LEMMA_ABSENCE candidate must be converted into a CourseElementSnapshot
              (F-LAPS-R012). Nullable -> the factory wires DefaultLemmaAbsenceProposalDeriver.
          - name: courseMapper
            type: CourseMapper
            description: >-
              FEAT-PIPRE. Pure CourseEntity -> AuditableCourse mapper used by the impact-preview computer to map the
              simulated course in memory. Required (no default): the engine cannot fabricate one because it would have
              to know about NlpTokenizer / QuizSentenceConverter wiring that lives outside revision-domain. The CLI
              passes the same instance it already wires for AuditRunner.
          - name: auditEngine
            type: AuditEngine
            description: >-
              FEAT-PIPRE. Re-runs the audit on the simulated AuditableCourse to produce the 'after' AuditReport without
              persisting any official report (F-PIPRE-R002). Required (no default): like courseMapper, lives in
              audit-domain whose IAuditEngine wiring is the CLI's responsibility.
          - name: impactPreviewStore
            type: ImpactPreviewStore
            description: >-
              FEAT-PIPRE. Filesystem (or future) sidecar store for the per-proposal preview. Required (no default): the
              persistence root is a CLI-level concern.
          - name: correctionContextOverrideParser
            type: CorrectionContextOverrideParser
            description: >-
              FEAT-REVCTX. Parser de overrides JSON usado por el engine cuando recibe la invocacion con override
              (revise(...) overload). Nullable -> la factory wirea DefaultCorrectionContextOverrideParser. La unica
              responsabilidad del parser es traducir el JSON crudo a un CorrectionContextOverride o lanzar
              OverrideRejectedException; el engine sigue siendo el que decide si invocar al parser segun el overload
              usado.
      - name: ApprovalMode
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: AUTO
            description: Bypass validator — auto-approves every proposal (R005, inherited from FEAT-REVBYP R007)
          - name: HUMAN
            description: Human validator — every proposal becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (R005/R007)
      - name: ProposalDecisionOutcomeKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: APPROVED_APPLIED
            description: Proposal approved and course rewritten (R011)
          - name: APPROVED_APPLY_FAILED
            description: Proposal approved and artifact rewritten, but course write failed (R011 step 6, DOUBT-ATOMICITY)
          - name: REJECTED
            description: Proposal rejected; course untouched (R012)
          - name: NOT_FOUND
            description: No proposal matches the supplied id (R002/R011/R012)
          - name: ALREADY_DECIDED
            description: Proposal exists but its verdict is not PENDING_APPROVAL (R013)
      - name: ProposalDecisionOutcome
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: kind
            type: ProposalDecisionOutcomeKind
          - name: artifact
            type: RevisionArtifact
            description: The artifact after the decision (APPROVED/REJECTED); null for NOT_FOUND
          - name: errorMessage
            type: String
            description: Human-readable message for NOT_FOUND/ALREADY_DECIDED/APPROVED_APPLY_FAILED
      - name: StrategyId
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: name
            type: String
            description: Symbolic identifier, e.g. 'lemma-absence-mvp' (F-LAPS-R005).
          - name: version
            type: String
            description: Version string, e.g. '1.0.0'; distinguishes revisions of the same name over time (F-LAPS-R005).
          - name: providerId
            type: String
            description: >-
              Opaque provider id for the underlying candidate generator, e.g. 'llm:anthropic', 'fixture:golden'.
              Nullable when the strategy has no external provider. Resolves DOUBT-STRATEGY-METADATA as the
              minimum-beyond-name+version metadata.
      - name: LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidate
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: quizSentence
            type: String
            description: >-
              Candidate exercise expressed in the FEAT-QSENT quizSentence DSL (blanks '____', answer blocks
              '[variant1|variant2]', hints inline in parentheses). One formal string encodes the sentence stem + blanks
              + correct answers + accepted variants (F-LAPS-R009, R011, R019). Parsed by QuizSentenceConverter.parse at
              derivation time (F-LAPS-R012). The strategy MAY but is not required to reuse substrings of the context's
              quizSentence (FEAT-RCLAQS) — it emits a fresh candidate.
          - name: translation
            type: String
            description: >-
              Spanish translation of the new exercise (F-LAPS-R009). Copied verbatim into elementAfter by the deriver
              (F-LAPS-R012). May differ from elementBefore.translation when the candidate changed the sentence meaning
              (F-LAPS-R013). The DSL of FEAT-QSENT does not cover translations, so this is a sibling field, not an
              additional entry inside quizSentence.
      - name: ProposalStrategyFailedException
        type: exception
        fields:
          - name: strategyName
            type: String
            description: Name of the strategy that failed (F-LAPS-R015).
          - name: taskId
            type: String
            description: Id of the task the strategy was attempting.
          - name: reason
            type: String
            description: Human-readable cause (empty generator response, provider down, etc.).
        message: "La estrategia de propuesta '%s' no pudo generar un candidato de quiz para la tarea '%s': %s"
        extends: RuntimeException
      - name: ProposalDerivationException
        type: exception
        fields:
          - name: strategyName
            type: String
            description: Name of the strategy whose candidate was rejected by the deriver.
          - name: taskId
            type: String
            description: Id of the task.
          - name: reason
            type: String
            description: Human-readable cause (invalid quizSentence grammar, empty translation, etc.).
        message: "No se pudo derivar elementAfter desde el candidato de la estrategia '%s' en la tarea '%s': %s"
        extends: RuntimeException
      - name: ConsolidatedViewBuilderConfig
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: activeAnalysisSelectionStore
            type: ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore
            description: >-
              Required. Lee/escribe el par activo. Adapter recomendado: FileSystemActiveAnalysisSelectionStore en
              audit-infrastructure.
          - name: auditReportStore
            type: AuditReportStore
            description: Required. Lee el AuditReport baseline.
          - name: refinementPlanStore
            type: RefinementPlanStore
            description: Required. Lee el RefinementPlan activo.
          - name: revisionArtifactStore
            type: RevisionArtifactStore
            description: Required. listByPlan(activePlanId) para obtener aceptadas y pendientes.
          - name: courseRepository
            type: CourseRepository
            description: Required. Carga CourseEntity desde coursePath.
          - name: courseElementLocator
            type: CourseElementLocator
            description: Required. snapshot/replace de elementos del curso.
          - name: courseMapper
            type: CourseMapper
            description: Required. CourseEntity -> AuditableCourse.
          - name: auditEngine
            type: AuditEngine
            description: Required. AuditableCourse -> AuditReport (in-memory, no persistido).
          - name: nodeFieldDiffer
            type: NodeFieldDiffer
            description: >-
              F-CDIFF v3. Required. Motor de descubrimiento dinamico inyectado por la composition root via
              DefaultNodeFieldDifferFactory.create(). El factory de ConsolidatedViewBuilder lo unpackea del config y lo
              pasa a DefaultConsolidatedViewBuilder.
        visibility: public
      - name: CorrectionContextSource
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: DERIVED
            description: >-
              El contexto fue derivado por el sistema desde el AuditReport y el plan persistente (camino historico de
              FEAT-REVBYP / FEAT-RCLA / FEAT-RCSL).
          - name: OVERRIDE
            description: El contexto fue provisto externamente por el cliente via revise --correction-context (FEAT-REVCTX R001).
      - name: CorrectionContextOverride
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: context
            type: CorrectionContext
            description: >-
              Contexto ya parseado y validado estructuralmente (R003) y por coherencia minima con la tarea persistida
              (nodeId + diagnosisKind, DOUBT-OVERRIDE-COHERENCE Opcion B). Es el mismo tipo que produce el
              CorrectionContextResolver; la estrategia activa lo consume sin saber su origen.
          - name: rawPayload
            type: String
            description: >-
              JSON crudo entregado por el cliente, conservado verbatim para auditabilidad (R002 #3,
              DOUBT-OVERRIDE-AUDITABILITY Opcion A). Viaja al RevisionArtifact y se persiste tal cual.
      - name: OverrideRejectedException
        type: exception
        fields:
          - name: reason
            type: String
            description: >-
              Mensaje accionable que identifica el motivo del rechazo (R003: campo faltante, tipo invalido, valor fuera
              de dominio; o sanity check fallido: nodeId/diagnosisKind no coinciden con la tarea persistida).
        message: "correctionContext override rejected: %s"
        extends: RuntimeException
    interfaces:
      - name: Reviser
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "propose(RefinementTask task, CorrectionContext context, CourseElementSnapshot before): RevisionProposal"
          - signature: "handles(DiagnosisKind kind): boolean"
          - signature: "reviserKind(): String"
      - name: RevisionValidator
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "validate(RevisionProposal proposal): RevisionValidatorResult"
      - name: RevisionValidatorResult
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "verdict(): RevisionVerdict"
          - signature: "rejectionReason(): Optional<String>"
      - name: RevisionArtifactStore
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "save(RevisionArtifact artifact): String"
          - signature: "load(String planId, String proposalId): Optional<RevisionArtifact>"
          - signature: "listByPlan(String planId): List<RevisionArtifact>"
          - signature: "findByProposalId(String proposalId, Optional<String> planId): Optional<RevisionArtifact>"
          - signature: "hasPendingProposalForTask(String planId, String taskId): boolean"
          - signature: "list(): List<RevisionArtifact>"
      - name: CourseElementLocator
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "snapshot(CourseEntity course, AuditTarget target, String nodeId): Optional<CourseElementSnapshot>"
          - signature: "replace(CourseEntity course, CourseElementSnapshot replacement): CourseEntity"
      - name: RevisionEngine
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "revise(String planId, String taskId, Path coursePath, String overridePayload): RevisionOutcome"
      - name: RevisionEngineFactory
        stereotype: factory
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "create(RevisionEngineConfig config): RevisionEngine"
      - name: RevisionValidatorFactory
        stereotype: factory
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: "create(ApprovalMode mode): RevisionValidator"
      - name: ProposalDecisionService
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: >-
              approve(String proposalId, Optional<String> planId, Optional<String> note, Path coursePath):
              ProposalDecisionOutcome
          - signature: "reject(String proposalId, Optional<String> planId, Optional<String> reason): ProposalDecisionOutcome"
      - name: ProposalDecisionServiceFactory
        stereotype: factory
        sealed: false
        exposes:

                  Dada una RevisionProposal sobre un quiz contenido en knowledge, milestone, topic y curso, cuando
                  compute corre, entonces el ImpactPreview.levelImpacts cubre la cadena jerarquica QUIZ -> KNOWLEDGE ->
                  TOPIC -> MILESTONE -> COURSE en orden de hoja a raiz
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R004
              - name: >-
                  Dada una RevisionProposal sobre un nodo cuyo arbol no contiene algun nivel intermedio, cuando compute
                  corre, entonces los niveles ausentes se omiten en lugar de reportarse como cero en levelImpacts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R004
              - name: >-
                  Dada una RevisionProposal cuyo elementAfter afecta multiples analyzers, cuando compute corre, entonces
                  el LevelImpact correspondiente expone un DimensionDelta por cada analyzer evaluado en ese nivel
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R005
              - name: >-
                  Dado un nivel donde un analyzer no aporta diagnosticos, cuando compute corre, entonces ese analyzer se
                  omite de dimensionDeltas en lugar de reportarse con delta cero
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R005
              - name: >-
                  Dado un ScoreDelta producido por compute para cualquier (nivel, dimension), entonces los tres campos
                  before, after y difference estan presentes y difference es exactamente after menos before
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R006
              - name: >-
                  Dada una RevisionProposal cuyo nodeId no se localiza en el currentCourse al simular, cuando compute
                  corre, entonces retorna un ImpactPreview con availability UNAVAILABLE, reason TARGET_NODE_ABSENT y
                  detail no vacio identificando el nodeId ausente
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R009
              - name: >-
                  Dado que AuditReportStore no puede recuperar la auditoria base del curso actual, cuando compute corre,

                  no vacio explicando la causa
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R009
              - name: >-
                  Dado que AuditEngine falla al recomputar scores sobre el curso simulado, cuando compute corre,
                  entonces retorna un ImpactPreview con availability UNAVAILABLE, reason SIMULATION_FAILED y detail no
                  vacio explicando la causa
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R009
              - name: >-
                  Dadas dos RevisionProposal distintas con el mismo currentCourse, cuando compute corre dos veces,
                  entonces produce dos ImpactPreview independientes con proposalId distinto y sin compartir levelImpacts
                  entre ambos
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R011
              - name: >-
                  Dada una RevisionProposal cuyo elementBefore y elementAfter referencian el mismo nodeId estable,
                  cuando compute corre, entonces el LevelImpact del nodo objetivo conserva ese nodeId en before y after
                  sin modelar renombres ni reubicaciones
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PIPRE
                  rule: F-PIPRE-R012
            implements:
              - ImpactPreviewComputer
          - name: DefaultConsolidatedViewBuilderFactory
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            implements:
              - ConsolidatedViewBuilderFactory
          - name: DefaultConsolidatedViewBuilder
            requiresInject:
              - name: revisionArtifactStore
                type: RevisionArtifactStore
                description: >-
                  listByPlan(activePlanId) y particionado por verdict: APPROVED se aplica como aceptada (contribuye a
                  consolidated y a NodeImpact.acceptedProposalIds); PENDING_APPROVAL se aplica como pendiente sobre el
                  consolidated (contribuye a pendingProjection y a NodeImpact.pendingProposalId, o cae en
                  NonApplicablePending si choca); REJECTED se descarta y no contribuye a ningun campo de la salida
                  (F-CDIFF-R005).
              - name: activeAnalysisSelectionStore
                type: ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore
                description: >-
                  Lee el par activo (auditId, planId). Si retorna Optional.empty, el builder produce ConsolidatedView
                  con availability=UNAVAILABLE/reason=NO_ACTIVE_ANALYSIS y nodeImpacts/statisticImpacts vacios
                  (F-CDIFF-R013).
              - name: auditReportStore
                type: AuditReportStore
                description: >-
                  Carga el AuditReport baseline correspondiente al activeAuditId. NUNCA se invoca .save sobre este
                  store; el builder solo lee (F-CDIFF-R015). Si la carga falla por inconsistencia, contribuye a
                  availability=UNAVAILABLE/reason=INCONSISTENT_PROPOSAL o REAGGREGATION_FAILED segun la causa.
              - name: refinementPlanStore
                type: RefinementPlanStore
                description: >-
                  Resuelve activePlanId dentro del activeAuditId. Si no se ubica,
                  availability=UNAVAILABLE/reason=ACTIVE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE (F-CDIFF-R013). NUNCA se invoca .save sobre
                  este store (F-CDIFF-R015).
              - name: courseRepository
                type: CourseRepository
                description: >-
                  Carga CourseEntity desde coursePath para que courseElementLocator pueda resolver snapshots y replaces
                  sobre el subarbol vigente.
              - name: courseElementLocator
                type: CourseElementLocator
                description: >-
                  snapshot(courseEntity, nodeId) y replace(courseEntity, elementAfter) para aplicar aceptadas y simular
                  pendientes en memoria. Si snapshot retorna empty para un nodeId referenciado por una pendiente, esa
                  pendiente cae en NonApplicablePending con reason=NODE_ABSENT (F-CDIFF-R012).
              - name: courseMapper
                type: CourseMapper
                description: >-
                  Pure transformation CourseEntity -> AuditableCourse, requerido como input al re-correr AuditEngine
                  sobre el subarbol modificado para re-agregar metricas de padres con la estrategia del analizador
                  (F-CDIFF-R008).
              - name: auditEngine
                type: AuditEngine
                description: >-
                  Re-corre runAudit sobre AuditableCourse derivado del curso post-aceptadas (consolidated) y
                  post-pendientes (pendingProjection). Si la re-agregacion falla,
                  availability=UNAVAILABLE/reason=REAGGREGATION_FAILED (F-CDIFF-R013).
              - name: nodeFieldDiffer
                type: NodeFieldDiffer
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R019/R020/R022/R023: el motor de descubrimiento dinamico que reemplaza la logica v2 de
                  snapshots crudos + collectStatisticImpacts. El builder le pasa los tres AuditNode (baseline /
                  consolidated / pendingProjection) por cada nodeTarget+nodeId tocado, y obtiene el mapa { fieldPath →
                  FieldChange } que copia tal cual a NodeImpact.fieldChanges. El builder NO interpreta el contenido del
                  mapa; es la frontera entre 'que campos cambiaron' (R019) y 'que decisiones del plan los provocaron'
                  (R011).
            types:
              - Component
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  Dada una seleccion activa con auditId y planId resolubles, cuando build corre, entonces
                  ConsolidatedView.activeAuditId y activePlanId coinciden con los identificadores leidos del

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un par activo cuyo planId no se puede ubicar dentro del analisis (RefinementPlanStore retorna

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

              - name: >-

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R013
              - name: >-
                  Dado que AuditEngine falla al recomputar agregaciones sobre el subarbol modificado, cuando build

                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

                traceability:

              - name: >-

              - name: >-

              - name: >-

              - name: >-

                  listByPlan(activePlanId) y las propuestas del plan ajeno no aparecen en nodeImpacts (ni como

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R017
              - name: >-

              - name: >-

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

              - name: >-
                  Dado un nodo cuyo subarbol no produce ningun field cambiado entre las tres fotos, cuando build corre,

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

              - name: >-

                traceability:

              - name: >-

                traceability:

              - name: >-

                  coincide identicamente con el valor que el AuditReport del segundo runAudit dejo en el AuditNode

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

              - name: >-
                  Dado un nodo hoja con una aceptada (que cambia el field) y una pendiente sobre el mismo nodeId (que lo

              - name: >-
