      - name: lemmaabsence
        description: >-
          Proposal-strategy SPI for LEMMA_ABSENCE. Public so the composition root and revision-infrastructure can both
          instantiate strategies and the canned generator and pass them into the registry builder. Houses: the
          candidate-generator port (LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator) plus its raw response carrier
          (LemmaAbsenceGeneratorResponse), the MVP strategy that delegates to the port (LemmaAbsenceMvpStrategy) and
          stamps the providerId injected at construction onto every StrategyId it emits (F-LAGEN-R009), and the canned
          generator kept as an offline fallback for CONTENT_AUDIT_LAGEN_MODE=canned (DOUBT-CANNED-MODE-AVAILABILITY ->
          Option B, CannedLemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator). Renamed from 'strategy' to 'lemmaabsence' so the package
          name describes the sub-domain it encapsulates instead of a GoF pattern label. The LlmGenerationFailureCategory
          enum lives in revision-infrastructure.lagen because revision-domain has zero consumers of it (no port mentions
          it; ProposalStrategyFailedException.reason is a free String that the adapter prefixes with the enum name).
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: LemmaAbsenceGeneratorResponse
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: quizSentence
                type: String
                description: Candidate expressed in the FEAT-QSENT quizSentence DSL; raw generator output before wrapping.
              - name: translation
                type: String
                description: Spanish translation of the candidate.
            visibility: public
        interfaces:
          - name: LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "generate(LemmaAbsenceCorrectionContext context): LemmaAbsenceGeneratorResponse"
            visibility: public
        implementations:
          - name: LemmaAbsenceMvpStrategy
            requiresInject:
              - name: generator
                type: LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator
                description: >-
                  Candidate generator the strategy delegates to. The composition root supplies either the canned
                  generator (CONTENT_AUDIT_LAGEN_MODE=canned) or an LLM-backed generator built by
                  LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory (default mode, F-LAGEN-R013).
              - name: providerId
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Provider identifier stamped onto every StrategyId this strategy emits (F-LAGEN-R009). Supplied by the
                  composition root: in LLM mode it is LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory.providerIdFor(LagenConfig) (format
                  'providerName:modelId' per DOUBT-PROVIDER-ID-FORMAT Option B); in canned mode the operator picks a
                  stable string. Required (the strategy never invents a default) so the provenance recorded on every
                  persisted RevisionProposal matches what the operator configured.
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: should stamp StrategyId.name = 'lemma-absence-llm' on every produced proposal
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R001
              - name: should stamp StrategyId.providerId from the injected generator's provider on every proposal
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: >-
                  should produce a LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidate by consuming exclusively the CorrectionContext fields
                  (quizSentence translation knowledgeTitle knowledgeInstructions topicLabel cefrLevel misplacedLemmas
                  suggestedLemmas) and never reading directly from AuditReport or the diagnoses tree
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R007
              - name: >-
                  should return exactly one LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidate per single propose invocation without ever
                  surfacing multiple alternatives for the operator to choose from
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R008
              - name: >-
                  should produce a LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidate that carries exactly two fields: a quizSentence string and
                  a translation string with both populated and no other element-level field present on the candidate
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R009
              - name: >-
                  should not require successive invocations on the same RefinementTask to return equal candidates
                  documenting that the strategy is non-deterministic by contract
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R010
              - name: >-
                  should emit only a candidate whose quizSentence is a string in the FEAT-QSENT DSL grammar plus a
                  translation string so that the strategy never returns plain sentence text quizForm parts or a fully
                  built elementAfter
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R011
              - name: >-
                  should not invoke any CEFR-level validator on the produced candidate's quizSentence so that even when
                  the generator returns vocabulary above cefrLevel the strategy returns the candidate as-is without
                  filtering
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R017
              - name: >-
                  should not apply any length limit to the produced candidate's quizSentence so that even an unusually
                  short or unusually long candidate is returned as-is without rejection
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAPS
                  rule: F-LAPS-R018
            implements:
              - LemmaAbsenceProposalStrategy
          - name: CannedLemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator
            requiresInject:
              - name: cannedQuizSentence
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Fixed quizSentence in the FEAT-QSENT DSL returned for every invocation. Used in offline/test mode
                  (CONTENT_AUDIT_LAGEN_MODE=canned) where no LLM provider is available. DOUBT-CANNED-MODE-AVAILABILITY
                  -> Option B (kept as opt-in, never default).
              - name: cannedTranslation
                type: String
                description: Fixed Spanish translation paired with cannedQuizSentence.
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: generate returns the same (cannedQuizSentence, cannedTranslation) pair on every invocation
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R012
              - name: generate returns the injected cannedQuizSentence and cannedTranslation verbatim with no transformation
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R012
              - name: >-
                  generate returns the same response regardless of differences in the LemmaAbsenceCorrectionContext
                  (quizSentence, cefrLevel, misplacedLemmas, suggestedLemmas)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R012
              - name: generate performs no I/O and never contacts an external provider
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R012
            implements:
              - LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator
      - name: impactpreview
        description: >-
          Public SPI for the impact preview of a RevisionProposal (FEAT-PIPRE). Houses the eager what-if contract
          (ImpactPreviewComputer port) and every carrier the operator-facing rendering needs to read: the diff tree
          (ImpactPreview, LevelImpact, DimensionDelta, ScoreDelta), the availability tagging (ImpactPreviewAvailability,
          ImpactPreviewUnavailability) and the closed taxonomy of unavailability causes
          (ImpactPreviewUnavailabilityReason). The persistence port (ImpactPreviewStore) lives at the module root next
          to RevisionArtifactStore so the audit-infrastructure adapter can target it with the same Public Port + Hidden
          Adapter shape it already uses for revision artifacts. Public so audit-cli can render the preview alongside
          each proposal. Kept inside revision-domain because every carrier is pure data over revision-domain types
          (AuditTarget, RevisionProposal) and the computer only needs the audit engine that revision-domain already
          accepts via dependsOn.
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: ImpactPreviewAvailability
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: AVAILABLE
                description: >-
                  The computer succeeded; deltas at every reported (level,dimension) pair are populated (F-PIPRE-R004,
                  F-PIPRE-R005, F-PIPRE-R006).
              - name: UNAVAILABLE
                description: >-
                  The computer could not produce deltas; ImpactPreview.unavailability carries the explicit cause
                  (F-PIPRE-R009). NOT the same as 'no change detected', which is AVAILABLE with all-zero differences
                  (F-PIPRE-R009 detail 2).
            visibility: public
          - name: ImpactPreviewUnavailabilityReason
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: TARGET_NODE_ABSENT
                description: >-
                  The proposal's nodeId could not be located in the course at preview time (F-PIPRE-R009 case 1,
                  F-PIPRE-J003).
              - name: BASE_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE
                description: >-
                  The AuditReport corresponding to the current course state could not be obtained as the 'before'
                  baseline (F-PIPRE-R009 case 2).
              - name: SIMULATION_FAILED
                description: >-
                  Producing the simulated course (replace + map + audit) failed for any reason other than the two above:
                  AuditEngine threw, the mapper rejected the simulated entity, or the simulated tree is structurally
                  inconsistent (F-PIPRE-R009 case 3).
              - name: OTHER
                description: >-
                  Any other unanticipated failure during preview computation. Detail string carries the human-readable
                  cause.
            visibility: public
          - name: ImpactPreviewUnavailability
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: ImpactPreviewUnavailabilityReason
                description: >-
                  Closed-set category, mirroring how F-LAGEN-R006 / LlmGenerationFailureCategory carry filterable
                  taxonomies.
              - name: detail
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Free-text human-readable explanation suitable for stderr / archived logs (F-PIPRE-R009 detail 4: 'la
                  causa registrada es texto legible para el operador').
            visibility: public
          - name: ScoreDelta
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: before
                type: double
                description: Score on the current course (domain scale 0..1 per F-PIPRE-R006 detail 2).
              - name: after
                type: double
                description: Score on the simulated course with elementAfter applied (domain scale 0..1).
              - name: difference
                type: double
                description: >-
                  after minus before. Carried explicitly so consumers do not re-derive the sign (F-PIPRE-R006 detail 1).
                  Operator-facing percentage rendering (F-PIPRE-R013) is the formatter's responsibility, not the
                  model's.
            visibility: public
          - name: DimensionDelta
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: dimension
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Analyzer name (the same key used in AuditNode.scores, e.g. 'lemma-absence', 'sentence-length',
                  'coca-buckets-distribution'). F-PIPRE-R005 'discrimina por dimension'. Open-ended String rather than
                  enum because dimensions are analyzer-defined and grow with each FEAT-D* / new analyzer.
              - name: delta
                type: ScoreDelta
                description: before/after/difference for this analyzer at the enclosing level (F-PIPRE-R005, F-PIPRE-R006).
            visibility: public
          - name: LevelImpact
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: nodeTarget
                type: AuditTarget
                description: "Hierarchy level: COURSE/MILESTONE/TOPIC/KNOWLEDGE/QUIZ (F-PIPRE-R004)."
              - name: nodeId
                type: String
                description: Identifier of the reported node. For COURSE level the AuditReport's root id is used.
              - name: aggregateDelta
                type: ScoreDelta
                description: >-
                  before/after/difference of the level's aggregate score (the same aggregate the auditor reports at this
                  node, e.g. AuditReportSummary.overallScore for the course root).
              - name: dimensionDeltas
                type: List<DimensionDelta>
                description: >-
                  One entry per analyzer that produces a score at this level. F-PIPRE-R005 detail 3: levels where a
                  dimension is not evaluated must omit it, not fabricate a zero delta.
            visibility: public
          - name: ImpactPreview
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: proposalId
                type: String
                description: >-
                  1:1 association with the originating RevisionProposal.proposalId (F-PIPRE-R001 detail 2). Stable
                  across reads; never reused across proposals (DOUBT-PROPOSAL-LIFECYCLE -> Option A).
              - name: computedAt
                type: Instant
                description: >-
                  Timestamp when the preview was computed. Mirrors the eager 'one shot at proposal time' contract of
                  F-PIPRE-R001 detail 1.
              - name: availability
                type: ImpactPreviewAvailability
                description: >-
                  AVAILABLE -> levelImpacts populated, unavailability null. UNAVAILABLE -> levelImpacts empty,
                  unavailability populated (F-PIPRE-R009).
              - name: unavailability
                type: ImpactPreviewUnavailability
                description: >-
                  Populated when availability=UNAVAILABLE; null when AVAILABLE. Carries the closed-set reason plus a
                  human-readable detail (F-PIPRE-R009).
              - name: levelImpacts
                type: List<LevelImpact>
                description: >-
                  Ordered chain from leaf (proposal's nodeTarget) up to COURSE root (F-PIPRE-R004). Intermediate levels
                  that do not exist for the targeted node are omitted, not zero-padded (F-PIPRE-R004 detail). Empty list
                  when availability=UNAVAILABLE.
            visibility: public
        interfaces:
          - name: ImpactPreviewComputer
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "compute(CourseEntity currentCourse, RevisionProposal proposal): ImpactPreview"
            visibility: public
            glossarySuggestions:
              - name: Impact Preview
                technicalName: ImpactPreview
                kind: domain-service-candidate
                basedOn: revision-domain/impactpreview/ImpactPreviewComputer
                derivedFrom:
                  - Revision Proposal
                  - Audit Report
                rationale: >
                  FEAT-PIPRE introduces the simulated 'what-if' projection of a proposal as a first-class capability of
                  the revision domain. Worth adopting as a canonical term once the analyst has reviewed the language.
      - name: consolidatedview
        description: >-
          FEAT-CDIFF v3. Public SPI for the consolidated structure that combines the baseline of an AuditReport with the
          effects of accepted and pending proposals of its active plan. Houses the builder port
          (ConsolidatedViewBuilder) plus its factory (ConsolidatedViewBuilderFactory) and every carrier the CLI
          rendering needs to read: the root document (ConsolidatedView), the per-node impact (NodeImpact carrying a
          uniform map of field-level changes), the field-change carrier (FieldChange triple), the field path
          (FieldPath), the non-applicable pending list (NonApplicablePending), the availability tagging
          (ConsolidatedViewAvailability + ConsolidatedViewUnavailability) and the closed taxonomies
          (ConsolidatedViewUnavailabilityReason, NonApplicablePendingReason). The previous StatisticImpact carrier
          disappeared in v3 (R009: scores are just fields of the map).
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: ConsolidatedViewAvailability
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: AVAILABLE
                description: >-
                  Construccion exitosa; nodeImpacts/statisticImpacts pueden estar vacios si ninguna propuesta afecta
                  nada.
              - name: UNAVAILABLE
                description: Construccion fallida; unavailability carga (categoria, detalle) explicita. F-CDIFF-R013.
            visibility: public
          - name: ConsolidatedViewUnavailabilityReason
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: NO_ACTIVE_ANALYSIS
                description: El curso no tiene par activo seleccionado o el auditId activo no existe.
              - name: ACTIVE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE
                description: El planId activo no se puede ubicar dentro del analisis (referencia rota, archivo ausente).
              - name: INCONSISTENT_PROPOSAL
                description: >-
                  Una propuesta aceptada referencia un nodeId que no se encuentra en el subarbol al momento de
                  re-agregar.
              - name: REAGGREGATION_FAILED
                description: El motor no puede recomputar el agregado sobre el subarbol modificado por las propuestas.
              - name: OTHER
                description: Cualquier otra causa, con detalle textual obligatorio en ConsolidatedViewUnavailability.detail.
            visibility: public
          - name: ConsolidatedViewUnavailability
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: ConsolidatedViewUnavailabilityReason
                description: Categoria cerrada de la causa.
              - name: detail
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Texto legible para el operador. F-CDIFF-R013 message: 'Estructura consolidada no disponible para el
                  analisis <auditId>: <categoria> - <detalle>'.
            visibility: public
          - name: NonApplicablePendingReason
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: NODE_ABSENT
                description: El nodeId de la pendiente no se encuentra en el subarbol vigente al momento de aplicar.
              - name: ELEMENT_BEFORE_MISMATCH
                description: >-
                  El elementBefore de la pendiente ya no coincide con el consolidated del nodo (otra aceptada lo
                  desplazo).
              - name: OTHER
                description: Cualquier otra causa de no-aplicabilidad, con detalle textual.
            visibility: public
          - name: NonApplicablePending
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: proposalId
                type: String
                description: Id de la propuesta pendiente.
              - name: reason
                type: NonApplicablePendingReason
                description: Categoria cerrada de la causa.
              - name: detail
                type: String
                description: Texto legible explicativo.
            visibility: public
          - name: NodeImpact
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: nodeTarget
                type: AuditTarget
                description: "Nivel jerarquico del nodo: QUIZ (hoja), KNOWLEDGE/TOPIC/MILESTONE/COURSE (padre)."
              - name: nodeId
                type: String
                description: Identificador del nodo afectado.
              - name: acceptedProposalIds
                type: List<String>
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R007 detail 1. Lista de proposalId aceptados que afectaron al nodo, ordenados por createdAt
                  ascendente. Vacia si no hay aceptadas sobre el nodo.
              - name: fieldChanges
                type: Map<String,FieldChange>
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R006/R019/R023. Mapa de hojas escalares con cambio. Clave: path estable producido por
                  FieldPath (R023). Valor: tripleta (original, consolidated, pendingProjection) producida por
                  NodeFieldDiffer recorriendo los tres AuditNode (R007 invariantes 1-3). Vacio si el nodo no tiene
                  fields que difieran entre al menos dos fotos modulo R020 — en ese caso el nodo no se incluye en
                  ConsolidatedView.nodeImpacts (R006 invariante 3).
              - name: pendingProposalIds
                type: List<String>
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R011 invariante 2. Lista de proposalId con veredicto PENDING_APPROVAL aplicable del plan
                  activo que afectaron al nodo (al contenido propio o al subarbol que contribuye a sus fotos). Vacia o
                  nula si no hay pendientes aplicables que toquen este nodo. Reemplaza al campo singular
                  pendingProposalId de v2 porque ahora un mismo nodo puede acumular varias pendientes aplicables sobre
                  fields distintos.
            visibility: public
          - name: ConsolidatedView
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: activeAuditId
                type: String
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R001 detail 2. Id del AuditReport resuelto por ActiveAnalysisSelectionStore.read(). null
                  cuando availability=UNAVAILABLE con reason=NO_ACTIVE_ANALYSIS.
              - name: activePlanId
                type: String
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R001 detail 2. Id del RefinementPlan activo. null cuando availability=UNAVAILABLE con reason
                  in {NO_ACTIVE_ANALYSIS, ACTIVE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE}.
              - name: availability
                type: ConsolidatedViewAvailability
                description: AVAILABLE / UNAVAILABLE.
              - name: unavailability
                type: ConsolidatedViewUnavailability
                description: F-CDIFF-R013. Poblado cuando availability=UNAVAILABLE; null cuando AVAILABLE.
              - name: computedAt
                type: Instant
                description: >-
                  Timestamp de construccion (auditoria del documento, no afecta semantica). Util para que el consumidor
                  distinga lecturas sucesivas.
              - name: nodeImpacts
                type: List<NodeImpact>
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R006/R008. Un entry por nodo del curso afectado por al menos una aceptada o pendiente del plan
                  activo. Vacio cuando availability=UNAVAILABLE; vacio tambien (pero AVAILABLE) cuando hay par activo
                  pero ninguna propuesta afecta nodos.
              - name: nonApplicablePendings
                type: List<NonApplicablePending>
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R012. Lista de pendientes que no se pudieron aplicar; cada una con (proposalId, reason,
                  detail). Se entrega aunque availability=AVAILABLE: la presencia de pendientes no aplicables NO degrada
                  la salida a UNAVAILABLE.
            visibility: public
          - name: FieldChange
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: original
                type: Object
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R007.1. Valor de la hoja en el baseline del AuditReport, copiado sin transformacion. null si
                  la hoja no existe en el baseline.
              - name: consolidated
                type: Object
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R007.2. Valor de la hoja en el AuditReport del subarbol con-aceptadas, copiado sin
                  transformacion. null si la hoja no existe en el consolidated.
              - name: pendingProjection
                type: Object
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R007.3. Valor de la hoja en el AuditReport del subarbol con aceptadas+pendientes aplicables,
                  copiado sin transformacion. null si la hoja no existe en pendingProjection.
            visibility: public
          - name: FieldPath
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: raw
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Representacion textual canonica de la clave del field. Es el valor que aparece como llave en
                  NodeImpact.fieldChanges.
            visibility: public
          - name: FieldExclusionRole
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: OPAQUE_PERSISTENCE_ID
                description: F-CDIFF-R020.1. Identificadores opacos generados por la persistencia (_id, $oid, formas equivalentes).
              - name: STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R020.2. Referencias estructurales que el dominio mantiene para navegacion (parentId, courseId,
                  milestoneId, topicId, knowledgeId, quizId cuando aparecen como referencia dentro de otro nodo, no como
                  identidad propia).
              - name: TIMESTAMP
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R020.3. Timestamps de creacion / actualizacion de cualquier nivel del modelo (Instant,
                  LocalDateTime sobre campos createdAt/updatedAt y similares).
              - name: INTERNAL_ORDER
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R020.4. Ordenes derivados de la posicion en disco / serializacion (indices de array de JSON,
                  claves de orden, contadores que el almacenamiento gestiona).
              - name: NON_SEMANTIC
                description: >-
                  F-CDIFF-R020.5. Categoria escape: cualquier valor cuya diferencia entre versiones no represente un
                  cambio semantico observable y que no caiga en las cuatro anteriores.
            visibility: public
        interfaces:
          - name: ConsolidatedViewBuilder
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "build(Path coursePath): ConsolidatedView"
            visibility: public
          - name: ConsolidatedViewBuilderFactory
            stereotype: factory
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "create(ConsolidatedViewBuilderConfig config): ConsolidatedViewBuilder"
            visibility: public
          - name: NodeFieldDiffer
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "diff(AuditNode original, AuditNode consolidated, AuditNode pendingProjection): Map<String,FieldChange>"
            visibility: public
      - name: fielddiff
        description: >-
          F-CDIFF v3. Motor interno del descubrimiento dinamico de fields cambiados que NodeFieldDiffer expone en su
          contrato publico. Aloja la implementacion recursiva (RecursiveNodeFieldDiffer), los dos registros centrales
          que materializan R020 y R022 sin contaminar los records de audit-domain / course-domain
          (FieldExclusionRegistry, ListIdentityRegistry) y los carriers internos del recorrido (FieldExclusionRule,
          ListIdentityRule, ListIdentityKeySpec). Solo la factory publica del motor cruza la frontera; el resto es
          package-private. Empaquetado aparte de consolidatedview porque la mecanica de diff es reutilizable: un futuro
          consumidor (p.ej. un validador estructural de cursos, otro analizador) puede pedir el mismo NodeFieldDiffer
          sin arrastrar la maquinaria del consolidado entero. El nombre fielddiff describe el concepto (diferenciacion a
          nivel de field) y no un patron GoF.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: FieldExclusionRule
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: declaringTypeName
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Nombre simple del tipo Java que declara el campo (p.ej. 'AuditableQuiz', 'AuditNode',
                  'MisplacedLemma'). El motor matchea por nombre simple para no acoplar el registry al package layout.
              - name: fieldName
                type: String
                description: Nombre del campo a excluir (p.ej. 'id', 'parentId', 'createdAt').
              - name: role
                type: FieldExclusionRole
                description: >-
                  Rol funcional asignado. Sirve a tooling de auditoria del registry para revisar la coherencia de las
                  exclusiones; el motor solo pregunta 'esta excluido?'.
            visibility: internal
          - name: ListIdentityKeySpec
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: fieldNames
                type: List<String>
                description: >-
                  Nombres de los campos que conforman la identidad natural del elemento. Si la lista es vacia, el match
                  no aplica y el motor cae en diff posicional (R022 caso 2).
            visibility: internal
          - name: ListIdentityRule
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: declaringTypeName
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Nombre simple del tipo Java que declara el campo lista (p.ej. 'LemmaAbsenceLevelDiagnosis',
                  'CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis').
              - name: fieldName
                type: String
                description: Nombre del campo lista (p.ej. 'absentLemmas', 'buckets', 'progressionAssessments').
              - name: keySpec
                type: ListIdentityKeySpec
                description: Definicion de la clave natural a usar para diff por elemento.
            visibility: internal
        interfaces:
          - name: FieldExclusionRegistry
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "isExcluded(String declaringTypeName, String fieldName): boolean"
              - signature: "getRole(String declaringTypeName, String fieldName): Optional<FieldExclusionRole>"
            visibility: internal
          - name: ListIdentityRegistry
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "getKeySpec(String declaringTypeName, String fieldName): Optional<ListIdentityKeySpec>"
            visibility: internal
          - name: NodeFieldDifferFactory
            stereotype: factory
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "create(): NodeFieldDiffer"
            visibility: public
        implementations:
          - name: RecursiveNodeFieldDiffer
            requiresInject:
              - name: exclusionRegistry
                type: FieldExclusionRegistry
                description: Consultado para cada hoja antes de emitirla. R020.
              - name: identityRegistry
                type: ListIdentityRegistry
                description: Consultado al alcanzar cada lista para decidir entre diff por elemento o posicional. R022.
            visibility: internal
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde una hoja escalar accesible por el recorrido recursivo tiene valores
                  distintos entre la foto original y la foto consolidated, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado
                  contiene una entrada cuya clave codifica el path a esa hoja y cuyo FieldChange lleva los tres valores
                  — R019 invariante 1: cobertura por construccion, sin enumeracion previa
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R019
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde una de las hojas escalares pertenece a un tipo de diagnostico no enumerado
                  en seed alguna del exclusionRegistry, cuando diff corre y los valores de esa hoja difieren entre
                  fotos, entonces la hoja aparece como field del mapa SIN requerir registro previo en ningun catalogo —
                  R019 invariante 2: aparicion automatica de cosas nuevas
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R019
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la unica diferencia entre fotos es un campo cuyo nombre el
                  exclusionRegistry clasifica como OPAQUE_PERSISTENCE_ID, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado
                  esta vacio: la hoja no se emite aunque difiera — R020 categoria 1
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la unica diferencia entre fotos es un campo cuyo nombre el
                  exclusionRegistry clasifica como STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado
                  esta vacio: la referencia estructural no se emite aunque difiera — R020 categoria 2
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la unica diferencia entre fotos es un campo cuyo nombre el
                  exclusionRegistry clasifica como TIMESTAMP, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado esta vacio:
                  el timestamp no se emite aunque difiera — R020 categoria 3
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la unica diferencia entre fotos es un campo cuyo nombre el
                  exclusionRegistry clasifica como INTERNAL_ORDER, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado esta
                  vacio: el orden interno no se emite aunque difiera — R020 categoria 4
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la unica diferencia entre fotos es un campo cuyo nombre el
                  exclusionRegistry clasifica como NON_SEMANTIC, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado esta
                  vacio: el campo no semantico no se emite aunque difiera — R020 categoria 5
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode con una lista cuyo tipo de elemento tiene identidad declarada en identityRegistry
                  (p.ej. List<AbsentLemma> con clave (lemma,pos)), donde un elemento existe en la foto original con
                  propiedades no-clave distintas a las de la foto consolidated, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa
                  retornado contiene fields derivados con clave estable basada en la identidad del elemento (no en su
                  indice posicional) — R022 invariante 1: lista con identidad
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R022
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode con una lista cuyo tipo de elemento NO tiene identidad declarada en
                  identityRegistry y donde el elemento en el indice i de la foto original tiene una hoja escalar
                  distinta al elemento en el indice i de la foto consolidated, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa
                  retornado contiene fields con clave de path posicional ([i]) — R022 invariante 2: diff posicional sin
                  identidad
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R022
              - name: >-
                  Dados tres AuditNode donde la misma hoja escalar profunda es alcanzable por la misma secuencia de
                  campos anidados en las tres fotos con valores distintos, cuando diff corre, entonces el mapa retornado
                  contiene UNA SOLA entrada cuya clave codifica esa secuencia y cuyo FieldChange agrupa los tres valores
                  (no tres entradas separadas, una por foto) — R023 invariante 1: estabilidad entre fotos
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R023
              - name: >-
                  Dadas dos invocaciones independientes de diff sobre dos pares de AuditNode del mismo tipo donde la
                  misma hoja anidada cambia bajo el mismo path, cuando diff corre en cada par, entonces ambos mapas
                  retornados contienen la MISMA clave para identificar el field correspondiente (sin variantes del path
                  por nodo) — R023 invariante 2: estabilidad entre nodos del mismo tipo
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R023
            implements:
              - NodeFieldDiffer
          - name: DefaultFieldExclusionRegistry
            visibility: internal
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de isExcluded sobre un campo seed del registry cuyo rol funcional es
                  OPAQUE_PERSISTENCE_ID, entonces retorna true y getRole retorna OPAQUE_PERSISTENCE_ID — R020 categoria
                  1: seed de identificadores opacos de persistencia
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de isExcluded sobre un campo seed del registry cuyo rol funcional es
                  STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE (parentId, courseId, milestoneId, topicId, knowledgeId o quizId como referencia
                  dentro de otro nodo), entonces retorna true y getRole retorna STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE — R020 categoria 2:
                  seed de referencias estructurales
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de isExcluded sobre un campo seed del registry cuyo rol funcional es TIMESTAMP
                  (createdAt, updatedAt sobre cualquier nivel del modelo), entonces retorna true y getRole retorna
                  TIMESTAMP — R020 categoria 3: seed de timestamps
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de isExcluded sobre un campo seed del registry cuyo rol funcional es
                  INTERNAL_ORDER (indice de orden de insercion gestionado por el almacenamiento), entonces retorna true
                  y getRole retorna INTERNAL_ORDER — R020 categoria 4: seed de ordenes internos
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de isExcluded sobre un campo seed del registry cuyo rol funcional cae en la
                  categoria escape NON_SEMANTIC, entonces retorna true y getRole retorna NON_SEMANTIC — R020 categoria
                  5: seed de la categoria escape
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R020
            implements:
              - FieldExclusionRegistry
          - name: DefaultListIdentityRegistry
            visibility: internal
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de getKeySpec sobre el campo lista de tipo List<AbsentLemma> dentro de
                  LemmaAbsenceLevelDiagnosis (declaringTypeName='LemmaAbsenceLevelDiagnosis', fieldName='absentLemmas'),
                  entonces retorna un Optional poblado con un ListIdentityKeySpec cuyos fieldNames son ['lemma','pos'] —
                  R022 seed AbsentLemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R022
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de getKeySpec sobre el campo lista de tipo List<MisplacedLemma> dentro de su
                  record contenedor, entonces retorna un Optional poblado con un ListIdentityKeySpec cuyos fieldNames
                  son ['lemma','pos'] — R022 seed MisplacedLemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF
                  rule: F-CDIFF-R022
              - name: >-
                  Dada una invocacion de getKeySpec sobre el campo lista de tipo List<BucketResult> (p.ej. dentro de
                  CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis), entonces retorna un Optional poblado con un ListIdentityKeySpec cuyos
                  fieldNames son ['bandName'] — R022 seed BucketResult
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-CDIFF

  - name: revision-infrastructure
    description: >-
      Infrastructure adapter for the revision phase. Provides the LLM-backed implementation of
      LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator (revision-domain.lemmaabsence port) using LangChain4j against any
      OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint (LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI cloud, Ollama via openai compat, etc.). Exposes a single
      Factory Seam (LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory + LagenConfig carrier + LlmGenerationFailureCategory enum) so the
      composition root wires the adapter with one call. The factory is the only piece that consumes LagenConfig: it
      reads the knobs, builds a ChatLanguageModel via the LangChain4j OpenAI builder, and passes that model directly
      into LemmaAbsenceLlmGenerator. The generator therefore depends on a chat-model abstraction (not on the LagenConfig
      record), keeping the inner adapter agnostic of how the model was configured. The adapter uses LangChain4j's legacy
      chat-message API flavor, generate(List<ChatMessage>), because F-LAGEN needs explicit system/user messages and a
      simple text response without exposing ChatRequest/ChatResponse in the architectural surface. The adapter, prompt
      builder, response parser and error classifier all live in an internal package; only the factory class is public.
      allowedClients=[audit-cli] enforces that this module is an implementation detail of the CLI composition root only
      (P8 Qualified Export).
    dependsOn:
      - revision-domain
      - refiner-domain
    allowedClients:
      - audit-cli
    patterns:
      - type: Factory
        implementations:
          - DefaultLemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory
        suppressed: false
        interface: LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory
    uses:
      - langchain4j-openai
      - langchain4j-core
    packages:
      - name: lagen
        description: >-
          Public contract of the LangChain4j-backed candidate generator. Exposes the factory port + the LagenConfig
          carrier (knobs from F-LAGEN-R008) + the LlmGenerationFailureCategory enum (categories surfaced through the
          adapter, F-LAGEN-R006). Implementations of the factory and all collaborators live in the sibling 'lagenopenai'
          internal package.
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: LagenConfig
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: providerName
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Short, stable identifier of the provider family (e.g. 'lmstudio', 'openai', 'anthropic-via-openai').
                  Used as the prefix of the providerId emitted into StrategyId.providerId (F-LAGEN-R009,
                  DOUBT-PROVIDER-ID-FORMAT -> Option B). Required.
              - name: modelId
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Model identifier within the provider, e.g. 'gemma-3-4b-it', 'gpt-4o-mini'. Joined with providerName as
                  'provider:model' to form StrategyId.providerId (F-LAGEN-R009). Required.
              - name: endpoint
                type: String
                description: >-
                  OpenAI-compatible chat/completions base URL, e.g. 'http://localhost:1234/v1' for the LM Studio
                  default. Required.
              - name: apiKey
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Bearer credential. Nullable: when absent, the adapter sends no Authorization header (covers local
                  providers without auth — see Assumption 3). When the provider rejects the request because of auth, the
                  adapter raises ProposalStrategyFailedException with reason prefixed LLM_AUTH_FAILED (F-LAGEN-R006).
              - name: temperature
                type: Double
                description: >-
                  Sampling temperature; controls output variability (F-LAGEN-R008). Nullable: when null the factory
                  applies a non-zero default (Assumption 4).
              - name: maxTokens
                type: Integer
                description: >-
                  Upper bound on response token count (F-LAGEN-R008). Nullable: when null the factory applies a sensible
                  default.
              - name: timeout
                type: Duration
                description: >-
                  Per-request budget; once exceeded the adapter raises ProposalStrategyFailedException with reason
                  prefixed LLM_TIMEOUT (F-LAGEN-R006). Nullable: when null the factory applies a default budget.
            visibility: public
          - name: LlmGenerationFailureCategory
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: LLM_UNREACHABLE
                description: >-
                  Communication with the provider could not be established (connection refused, host unreachable, DNS
                  error, misconfigured endpoint). F-LAGEN-R006.
              - name: LLM_TIMEOUT
                description: >-
                  The query exceeded the configured time budget without returning a response. F-LAGEN-R006,
                  F-LAGEN-R008.
              - name: LLM_AUTH_FAILED
                description: The provider rejected the request because credentials were invalid or absent. F-LAGEN-R006.
              - name: LLM_RESPONSE_EMPTY
                description: >-
                  The query completed successfully but the model returned no content (empty string, no text).
                  F-LAGEN-R006.
              - name: LLM_RESPONSE_MALFORMED
                description: >-
                  The model returned content that does not satisfy F-LAGEN-R005 (not parseable JSON, missing
                  quizSentence/translation, or either field empty/non-string). F-LAGEN-R006.
              - name: LLM_OTHER
                description: Any other generation-time failure not covered by the categories above. F-LAGEN-R006.
            visibility: public
          - name: LagenDefaults
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: temperature
                type: double
                description: >-
                  Default temperature applied by the factory when LagenConfig.temperature is null. Pinned to 0.7
                  (Asuncion 4: non-zero / non-deterministic).
              - name: maxTokens
                type: int
                description: >-
                  Default maxTokens applied by the factory when LagenConfig.maxTokens is null. Pinned to 2048 (sized for
                  one cloze quizSentence + translation pair).
              - name: timeout
                type: Duration
                description: >-
                  Default timeout applied by the factory when LagenConfig.timeout is null. Pinned to
                  Duration.ofSeconds(30) (alineado con el ejemplo LLM_TIMEOUT en REQUIREMENT.md R006).
            visibility: public
          - name: InvalidProviderIdException
            type: exception
            fields:
              - name: providerName
                type: String
              - name: modelId
                type: String
            message: >-
              providerName and modelId must not contain ':' (got providerName='%s', modelId='%s'). The ':' is reserved
              as the providerId separator (provider:model).
            visibility: public
            extends: RuntimeException
        interfaces:
          - name: LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory
            stereotype: factory
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "create(LagenConfig config): LemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator"
              - signature: "providerIdFor(LagenConfig config): String"
            visibility: public
      - name: lagenopenai
        description: >-
          Internal LangChain4j-OpenAI engine. Only DefaultLemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory is public (the seam —
          instantiated once by audit-cli.bootstrap); every collaborator (LemmaAbsenceLlmGenerator,
          LemmaAbsencePromptBuilder, LemmaAbsenceResponseParser, LangChainErrorClassifier) is package-private so other
          modules cannot bypass the factory port. The generator depends on a ChatLanguageModel that the factory builds
          from LagenConfig — the engine never sees the LagenConfig itself, only the configured chat-model abstraction.
          Replacing the LLM client implementation never changes this module's public surface.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: LemmaAbsenceLlmRawResponse
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: rawText
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Raw text content returned by the model before JSON parsing. Empty string represents LLM_RESPONSE_EMPTY
                  (F-LAGEN-R006).
        interfaces:
          - name: LemmaAbsencePromptBuilder
            stereotype: service
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "buildSystemPrompt(): String"
              - signature: "buildUserPrompt(LemmaAbsenceCorrectionContext context): String"
            visibility: internal
          - name: LemmaAbsenceResponseParser
            stereotype: service
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: >-
                  parse(LemmaAbsenceLlmRawResponse raw, String taskId, String strategyName):
                  LemmaAbsenceGeneratorResponse
            visibility: internal
          - name: LangChainErrorClassifier
            stereotype: service
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "classify(Throwable cause): LlmGenerationFailureCategory"
            visibility: internal
        implementations:
          - name: DefaultLemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory
            types:
              - Component
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: create returns a generator whose strategyName is 'lemma-absence-llm'
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R001
              - name: providerIdFor yields different values for two LagenConfigs that differ in providerName
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: providerIdFor yields different values for two LagenConfigs that differ in modelId
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: create propagates explicit endpoint, modelId and apiKey from LagenConfig into the configured generator
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: >-
                  create propagates explicit temperature, maxTokens and timeout from LagenConfig into the configured
                  generator
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: create sends no Authorization header when LagenConfig.apiKey is null
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: providerIdFor returns 'providerName:modelId' joining the two LagenConfig fields with a literal ':'
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: providerIdFor preserves the case of providerName and modelId verbatim (no lowercasing)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: >-
                  providerIdFor preserves leading and trailing whitespace inside providerName and modelId verbatim (no
                  trimming)
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: providerIdFor raises InvalidProviderIdException when LagenConfig.providerName contains ':'
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: providerIdFor raises InvalidProviderIdException when LagenConfig.modelId contains ':'
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R009
              - name: create applies LagenDefaults.temperature (0.7) when LagenConfig.temperature is null
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R011
              - name: create applies LagenDefaults.maxTokens (2048) when LagenConfig.maxTokens is null
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
              - name: create applies LagenDefaults.timeout (Duration.ofSeconds(30)) when LagenConfig.timeout is null
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LAGEN
                  rule: F-LAGEN-R008
            implements:
              - LemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory
          - name: LemmaAbsenceLlmGenerator
            requiresInject:

              - name: promptBuilder

              - name: responseParser

              - name: errorClassifier
                type: LangChainErrorClassifier
              - name: strategyName
                type: String
                description: >-
                  Strategy name embedded in any ProposalStrategyFailedException raised by this adapter. Wired to
                  'lemma-absence-llm' (F-LAGEN-R001) by the factory.
              - name: chatModel
                type: ChatLanguageModel
                description: >-
                  LangChain4j chat-model abstraction the generator calls via generate(List<ChatMessage>). Built once by
                  DefaultLemmaAbsenceLlmGeneratorFactory from a LagenConfig (endpoint + modelId + apiKey + temperature +
                  maxTokens + timeout). The generator never sees the LagenConfig itself, keeping it agnostic of how the

            types:

You are an architecture reviewer evaluating whether the proposed architectural patch respects the SINGLE RESPONSIBILITY PRINCIPLE (SRP) at the module and implementation level.

## Sentinel DSL Reference
## Module

```yaml
modules:
  - name: string              # Module name (e.g., "payments", "domain")
    description: string        # What this module is responsible for
    layer: domain|infrastructure|application  # Hexagonal layer (enables A4 eval checks)
    scope: public|internal     # "public" = exported API, "internal" = generates module-info.java
    dependsOn: [string]        # Other module names this depends on (ArchUnit-enforced)
    allowedClients: [string]   # Restrict which modules can depend on this (JPMS qualified exports)
    uses: [string]             # Aliases of root-level dependencies this module uses
    models: [Model]
    interfaces: [Interface]
    implementations: [Implementation]
    packages: [Package]           # Organizational groupings with visibility control
    patterns: [PatternDeclaration]
```

**`layer`** — Declares the module's hexagonal architecture role:
- `domain`: Defines ports (interfaces), models, and business rules. Must NOT depend on infrastructure or application modules.
- `infrastructure` (or `infra`): Adapters that implement domain ports. Depends only on domain.
- `application` (or `app`): Entry points and composition root. Wires domain + infra together.

When declared, the eval framework (A4) validates dependency inversion, acyclicity, adapter polarity, and layer isolation. Strongly recommended for all modules.

---

## Package

Packages are **organizational groupings** within a module. They create Java sub-packages with visibility control but do NOT create separate Maven modules.

```yaml
packages:
  - name: string              # lowercase Java identifier (e.g., "analyzers", "validation")
    description: string        # What this package is responsible for
    visibility: public|internal|private  # Default: internal
    allowedClients: [string]   # Optional: narrow a public package to a specific list of consumer modules
    models: [Model]            # Models in this package
    interfaces: [Interface]    # Interfaces in this package
    implementations: [Implementation]  # Implementations in this package
```

**`allowedClients` on a package** — only meaningful when `visibility: "public"`. Narrows the public package's reach from "every module that can see the owning module" down to the listed modules. Generates an additional ArchUnit rule. Use this when one module exposes multiple public packages but each is meant for a different consumer (e.g., an `api` package consumed only by the CLI, a `spi` package consumed only by plugin authors).

**Visibility:**
- `public` — Accessible from any module (exported API of this module)
- `internal` (default) — Accessible within this module only, not from other modules
- `private` — Accessible only within this package, not even from the module root

**Java mapping:** Module `domain` (base `com.acme.domain`) with package `analyzers` → `com.acme.domain.analyzers`

**ArchUnit enforcement:** Generated rules prevent external access to `internal` and `private` packages.

**Sub-domain encapsulation pattern:** Use packages to model sub-domains that expose a public interface and/or model but hide their internal implementation. Place the contract (interface + shared models) in a `public` package and the implementations in an `internal` or `private` sibling package. This enforces that consumers depend on the contract, never on the implementation details.

Example — a `pricing` sub-domain inside an `orders` module:
```yaml
packages:
  - name: "pricing"
    visibility: "public"          # Exposed contract
    interfaces:
      - name: "PricingEngine"
        exposes:
          - signature: "calculate(Order order): PriceBreakdown"
    models:
      - name: "PriceBreakdown"
        fields:
          - { name: "subtotal", type: "BigDecimal" }
          - { name: "tax", type: "BigDecimal" }
          - { name: "total", type: "BigDecimal" }
  - name: "pricinginternal"
    visibility: "private"          # Hidden implementation
    implementations:
      - name: "TieredPricingEngine"
        implements: ["PricingEngine"]
        requiresInject:
          - { name: "discountRepository", type: "DiscountRepository" }
```

**Relocate (cross-scope move).** Moving an element from the module root into a package (or between packages) is **not** a primitive — it is `_change: "delete"` at the old scope plus `_change: "add"` at the new scope, in the same patch:

```yaml
modules:
  - name: "domain"
    _change: "modify"
    implementations:
      - name: "OrderAnalyzer"
        _change: "delete"          # remove from module root
    packages:
      - name: "analyzers"
        _change: "modify"           # or "add" if the package is new
        implementations:
          - name: "OrderAnalyzer"
            _change: "add"          # re-add at the new location
            implements: ["Analyzer"]
```

Merge-by-name is **scoped**: a root-level `OrderAnalyzer` and `analyzers.OrderAnalyzer` are distinct entries. `patch propose` does not detect duplicate-name collisions across scopes — the conflict only surfaces at `sentinel generate` time. Always emit the delete + add pair explicitly when relocating.

---

## Model

```yaml
models:
  - name: string              # PascalCase (e.g., "Order", "OrderStatus")
    type: record|enum|exception # record = Java record, enum = Java enum, exception = RuntimeException subclass
    visibility: public|internal # Default: public. "internal" = package-private Java class
    extends: string            # Optional supertype (default: RuntimeException for exceptions)
    implements: [string]        # Optional: interfaces this model implements (marker interfaces, sealed hierarchies)
    message: string            # Optional message template for exceptions (uses String.format with field values)
    fields:
      - name: string           # camelCase for records, UPPER_CASE for enum constants
        type: string           # Java type (ignored for enums)
        description: string    # Optional documentation
```

Exception example:
```yaml
  - name: "OrderNotFoundException"
    type: exception
    extends: "RuntimeException"   # default, can be omitted
    message: "Order not found: %s" # %s placeholders filled from fields in order
    fields:
      - { name: "orderId", type: "UUID" }
```

---

## Interface

```yaml
interfaces:
  - name: string              # PascalCase (e.g., "OrderRepository")
    stereotype: string         # Free-text label: "port", "gateway", "repository", etc.
    visibility: public|internal # Default: public. "internal" = package-private interface
    sealed: boolean            # true = only declared implementations allowed
    typeParameters: [string]   # Optional generic type parameters (e.g., ["T extends Bound"])
    exposes:
      - signature: string      # "methodName(Type arg): ReturnType"
        throws: [string]       # Optional exception types
        _change: add|modify|delete  # Optional — for removing individual signatures in patches
```

**Signature format:** `methodName(Type argName, Type2 argName2): ReturnType`

- Parameters can be type-only (`read(Path): Result`) or type + name (`read(Path path): Result`)
- Use `:` to separate return type — NOT `->` or `=>`
- No space between method name and `(` — `send(...)` not `send (...)`
- Generics without spaces: `Map<String,Object>` not `Map<String, Object>`
- `_change: "delete"` on a signature removes that single method from the interface without deleting the whole interface
- `patch propose` does NOT validate signatures — malformed signatures pass proposal but fail during `sentinel generate`

When `typeParameters` is set, method signatures can reference the type variables (e.g. `resolve(Report r): Optional<T>`). Implementations specify the concrete type via `implements: ["InterfaceName<ConcreteType>"]`.

---

## Implementation

```yaml
implementations:
  - name: string              # PascalCase (e.g., "PostgresOrderAdapter")
    stereotype: class          # Optional. "class" = standalone class (own contract).
                               #   Omit for default adapter behavior.
    implements: [string]       # Interfaces this class implements (required unless stereotype: class)
    exposes:                   # Methods exposed by this class (used with stereotype: class)
      - signature: string      # Same format as interface exposes
    visibility: public|internal # Default: internal (package-private). "public" = accessible cross-module
    externalImplements:        # External framework/library interfaces (FQN with generics)
      - string                 # e.g., "java.util.concurrent.Callable<Integer>"
    requiresInject:            # Constructor-injected dependencies
      - name: string           # camelCase dependency name
        type: string           # Interface or class type being injected
    types: [string]            # Framework annotations: Component, Service, Repository,
                               #   RestController, UseCase, Adapter
```

### `stereotype: class` (Standalone Class)

A `stereotype: class` implementation **is its own contract** — it fuses interface + implementation into a single artifact. It has `exposes:` (like interfaces) but generates a concrete class directly with no paired interface.

**Use `stereotype: class` when:**
- The element is an entry point with `externalImplements` (CLI command, controller)
- The element is in a `private` package and only consumed by siblings
- The element is a use-case orchestrator with 1 consumer and no foreseeable second impl

**Use interface + impl (default) when:**
- The element is a port consumed cross-module via `requiresInject`
- Multiple implementations exist (Strategy, Factory patterns)
- `sealed: true` communicates a design constraint
- DIP justifies the separation (infra adapter implementing domain port)

**Rules:**
- `stereotype: class` CANNOT have `implements:` — that's a contradiction
- `stereotype: class` CANNOT be injected by other implementations via `requiresInject` — if something needs to consume it, extract an interface
- `stereotype: class` MUST have `exposes:` defining its public contract

**`externalImplements`** — Use when the implementation class must implement an interface from an external framework or the JDK (e.g., picocli's `Callable<Integer>`, Spring's `InitializingBean`, Jackson's `Serializer<T>`). These are NOT validated against sentinel interfaces and are passed through to the generated class declaration as-is. Always use the fully-qualified name.

### Visibility Defaults

| Component | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Model | `public` | Accessible from any module |
| Interface | `public` | Accessible from any module |
| Implementation | `internal` | Package-private (same module only) |

Implementations are internal by default — external modules depend on interfaces, not concrete classes. Use `visibility: "public"` on an implementation only when it must be instantiated from another module (e.g., CLI wiring, factory classes).

# Consulta de Suggested Lemmas a través del CLI

## TL;DR

Se amplía `GetCommand.get(...)` para consultar `Suggested Lemmas` bajo demanda durante la revisión de una `Task/Quiz`.  
La consulta se identifica por `taskId`, permite pedir un `limit`, filtrar por `Part of Speech` y `Level`, y siempre devuelve resultados priorizados.  
El cambio complementa los `suggestedLemmas` estáticos del `correctionContext` sin crear un nuevo verbo CLI.

## Recorrido de uso (estado actual)

Hoy el cliente puede generar o recibir contexto de corrección usando `PlanCommand.plan(..., withCorrectionContext = true)` y luego ejecutar la revisión con `ReviseCommand.revise(taskId, planId, correctionContextJson, correctionContextFilePath)`. En ese recorrido, los `suggestedLemmas` llegan como parte estática del `correctionContext`.

Cuando el agente revisor detecta que esos `suggestedLemmas` estáticos no cubren la necesidad de la quiz —por ejemplo, la quiz necesita un verbo y la lista disponible no contiene verbos útiles— no existe hoy una consulta pública específica para pedir más `Suggested Lemmas`. `GetCommand.get(resource, name, filter)` ya es el verbo público natural para leer recursos consultables como tasks, plans, audits o analyzers, pero todavía no expone `"suggested-lemmas"` como recurso independiente.

La fricción funcional es que el agente queda limitado al top estático incluido previamente en el `correctionContext`, aunque necesite más candidatos, un tipo gramatical específico o un filtrado por `Level`. Resolverlo mediante `proposalId` o mediante versiones proyectadas temporales queda fuera de este primer alcance.

**Cambio mínimo necesario**: extender el verbo público existente `GetCommand.get(...)` para soportar `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(limit, partOfSpeech, level))`, usando `taskId` como identidad de la `Task/Quiz` en revisión, aplicando siempre filtrado por `Level`, filtrado opcional por `Part of Speech`, límite máximo solicitado y orden por prioridad de recomendación.

## Business Rules

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R001] - Exposición pública de suggested lemmas por task
**Severity**: critical | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando un cliente invoca `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(...))`, el sistema debe devolver los `Suggested Lemmas` aplicables a la `Task/Quiz` identificada por `taskId`. La identidad pública de la consulta es la task en revisión, no una propuesta.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R002] - Uso del verbo existente get
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

La consulta dinámica de `Suggested Lemmas` debe resolverse extendiendo `GetCommand.get(...)` con el recurso `"suggested-lemmas"`. Esta primera versión no debe introducir un nuevo verbo CLI para cubrir la misma necesidad.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R003] - Filtrado obligatorio por level
**Severity**: critical | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Toda respuesta exitosa de `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` debe incluir únicamente lemas adecuados al `Level` aplicable a la `Task/Quiz`. El sistema no debe devolver sugerencias sin aplicar un filtro de nivel.

**Error**: "No se pueden sugerir lemas sin un nivel aplicable para filtrar." [ASSUMPTION]

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R004] - Inferencia de level desde la task
**Severity**: critical | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` se invoca sin un `level` explícito, el sistema debe intentar inferir el `Level` desde la `Task/Quiz` o desde su contexto disponible. Si logra inferirlo, debe usar ese nivel para filtrar los resultados.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R005] - Validación cuando no hay level disponible
**Severity**: critical | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` se invoca sin `level` explícito y el sistema no puede inferir el `Level`, la consulta debe rechazarse con una validación clara. El sistema no debe devolver `Suggested Lemmas` sin filtro de nivel.

**Error**: "No se pueden sugerir lemas porque falta el nivel necesario para filtrar." [ASSUMPTION]

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R006] - Uso de level explícito cuando no puede inferirse
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(..., level = <level>))` incluye un `level` explícito y el sistema no puede inferir el `Level` desde la task, debe usar el nivel informado para filtrar los `Suggested Lemmas`.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R007] - Filtro por partOfSpeech
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(..., partOfSpeech = <partOfSpeech>))` incluye `partOfSpeech`, el sistema debe devolver únicamente lemas cuyo `Part of Speech` coincida con el filtro solicitado. El sistema no debe ampliar ni ignorar silenciosamente ese filtro.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R008] - Límite máximo solicitado
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(limit = N, ...))` incluye `limit = N`, el sistema debe devolver como máximo `N` `Suggested Lemmas` que cumplan los filtros aplicables.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R009] - Lista parcial sin error
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando la cantidad de `Suggested Lemmas` disponibles para el `Level`, el `Part of Speech` y los demás criterios soportados sea menor que el `limit` solicitado, el sistema debe devolver todos los resultados disponibles sin considerar la situación como error.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R010] - Ordenamiento por prioridad
**Severity**: critical | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Toda respuesta exitosa con uno o más `Suggested Lemmas` debe devolverlos en orden de prioridad de recomendación. El cliente o agente revisor no debe necesitar ordenar los resultados por su cuenta.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R011] - Consulta no limitada al top estático del correctionContext
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando el agente solicita más lemas que los incluidos originalmente en `correctionContext.suggestedLemmas`, `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` debe poder devolver una lista más amplia que el conjunto estático histórico, respetando `limit`, `Level`, `Part of Speech` y orden de prioridad.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R012] - Tasks sin suggested lemmas aplicables
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando una `Task/Quiz` no tenga una base funcional compatible para sugerir lemas, `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` debe devolver una respuesta vacía con una explicación funcional clara. El sistema no debe inventar `Suggested Lemmas`.

**Error**: "No hay lemas sugeridos disponibles para esta task." [ASSUMPTION]

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R013] - Filtros no soportados
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Cuando `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(...))` reciba un filtro fuera del alcance inicial, como `isIrregular`, el sistema debe responder con una validación clara indicando que ese filtro no está disponible para la consulta de `Suggested Lemmas`. El sistema no debe ignorarlo silenciosamente.

**Error**: "El filtro solicitado no está soportado para suggested-lemmas." [ASSUMPTION]

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R014] - Resultado mínimo observable
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Toda respuesta exitosa de `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, ...)` debe permitir identificar cada lema sugerido. El orden de aparición en la respuesta representa su prioridad relativa.

**Error**: "No aplica."

### Rule[F-CSLATDC-R015] - Instrucciones de uso para el agente revisor
**Severity**: major | **Validation**: VALIDATED

Las instrucciones funcionales del agente revisor deben indicarle que, cuando los `suggestedLemmas` estáticos del `correctionContext` no cubran la necesidad de la `Task/Quiz`, puede usar `GetCommand.get("suggested-lemmas", <taskId>, GetTasksFilter(limit, partOfSpeech, level))` para pedir más lemas, respetando el `Level`, el `Part of Speech` requerido y el orden de prioridad devuelto.

**Error**: "No aplica."

## Context

Los `Suggested Lemmas` ya existen como parte del `correctionContext` usado en revisión, especialmente en escenarios vinculados a `LEMMA_ABSENCE`. Ese diseño funciona cuando la lista estática alcanza para orientar al agente, pero no cubre bien quizzes que necesitan un tipo gramatical concreto o una cantidad mayor de candidatos.

La necesidad funcional no es explorar tareas, planes o propuestas de manera externa. La necesidad es puntual: durante la revisión de una `Task/Quiz`, el agente debe poder pedir más candidatos relevantes y priorizados para completar la revisión con mejores insumos.

La solución se mantiene como una ampliación mínima del contrato público existente: se reutiliza `GetCommand.get(...)`, se agrega el recurso `"suggested-lemmas"` y se usa `taskId` como identidad pública. La consulta complementa el `correctionContext`; no redefine el contenido estático existente.

## Scope

### IN

- Extender `GetCommand.get(...)` con el recurso `"suggested-lemmas"`.
- Identificar la consulta por `taskId`.
- Permitir `limit` como cantidad máxima solicitada.
- Soportar filtro por `partOfSpeech`.
- Soportar filtrado por `level`.
- Inferir el `Level` desde la `Task/Quiz` o su contexto cuando sea posible.
- Permitir `level` explícito cuando no pueda inferirse.
- Devolver resultados siempre en orden de prioridad.
- Devolver menos resultados que el `limit` sin error.
- Devolver lista vacía con explicación funcional cuando no haya `Suggested Lemmas` aplicables.
- Instruir al agente revisor para usar la consulta cuando los `suggestedLemmas` estáticos no cubran la necesidad de la quiz.

### OUT

- No se agrega soporte inicial para `proposalId`.
- No se modelan los `Suggested Lemmas` como pertenecientes a una propuesta ya generada.
- No se agrega el filtro `isIrregular` en esta primera versión.
- No se resuelve en esta iteración el acceso a versiones proyectadas temporales generadas por otros flujos.
- No se agregan filtros léxicos adicionales fuera de `partOfSpeech`, `level` y `limit`.
- No se redefine el contenido estático de `correctionContext.suggestedLemmas`.
- No se incluye un flujo de exploración externa de tasks, planes o propuestas.

```yaml
  - id: task_under_review

  - id: determine_level
    action: "El sistema determina el Level aplicable para la consulta"
    gate: [F-CSLATDC-R003, F-CSLATDC-R004]
    outcomes:
      - when: "El Level puede inferirse desde la Task/Quiz o su contexto"
        then: apply_supported_filters
      - when: "El Level no puede inferirse y no fue informado explícitamente"

    action: "La respuesta rechaza la consulta con una validación clara e indica que el filtro solicitado no está soportado"
    result: failure
```

```yaml
  - id: accept_supported_filters
    action: "La consulta continúa usando únicamente los filtros soportados"
    result: success
```
