# Tech Spec: Consulta de Suggested Lemmas a través del CLI

## Extiende el filtro del CLI para la consulta semántica

La consulta de suggested lemmas necesita aceptar criterios que no pertenecen al listado genérico de tareas, pero sí al caso de uso de exploración de vocabulario. Mantenerlos en el filtro del comando evita crear un canal paralelo de parámetros y permite que el CLI construya una intención única antes de delegar al dominio. El uso de valores opcionales deja intacto el comportamiento existente cuando el usuario no solicita filtrado adicional.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "audit-cli"
    _change: "modify"
    models:
      - name: "GetTasksFilter"
        _change: "modify"
        fields:
          - name: "partOfSpeech"
            type: "Optional<String>"
            description: "Optional part-of-speech filter for suggested lemma queries"
          - name: "level"
            type: "Optional<CefrLevel>"
            description: "Optional CEFR level override for suggested lemma queries"
```

## Inyecta el puerto de consulta en el comando get

El comando debe poder resolver la consulta sin conocer los detalles de ranking, inferencia de nivel o construcción de candidatos. La dependencia contra el puerto mantiene el CLI como adaptador de entrada y evita acoplarlo al motor interno del dominio. Esta decisión concentra la lógica funcional en `refiner-domain` y deja al comando únicamente con la responsabilidad de orquestar entrada y salida.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "audit-cli"
    _change: "modify"
    packages:
      - name: "commands"
        _change: "modify"
        implementations:
          - name: "GetCmd"
            _change: "modify"
            implements: ["GetCommand"]
            requiresInject:
              - name: "suggestedLemmaQueryService"
                type: "SuggestedLemmaQueryService"
```

## Añade el contrato de entrada de suggested lemmas

El dominio necesita una petición explícita para separar los parámetros funcionales de los detalles propios del CLI. El record hace que la consulta sea portable para otros adaptadores futuros y preserva la posibilidad de inferir el nivel desde el reporte cuando no se recibe una preferencia explícita. También evita que el servicio tenga una firma con demasiados argumentos primitivos.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    models:
      - name: "SuggestedLemmaQuery"
        _change: "add"
        type: "record"
        visibility: "public"
        fields:
          - name: "taskId"
            type: "String"
            description: "Refinement task identifier to query suggested lemmas for"
          - name: "limit"
            type: "Optional<Integer>"
            description: "Optional maximum number of suggested lemmas to return"
          - name: "partOfSpeech"
            type: "Optional<String>"
            description: "Optional part-of-speech filter"
          - name: "level"
            type: "Optional<CefrLevel>"
            description: "Optional explicit CEFR level; inferred from the audit report when absent"
```

## Añade el resultado público de la consulta

El caso de uso requiere devolver tanto los lemmas como el contexto que explica cómo se obtuvo la respuesta. Incluir el nivel efectivo en el resultado hace visible la decisión de inferencia sin filtrar detalles del motor. El mensaje funcional permite representar resultados vacíos o parciales sin convertir todos esos casos en errores técnicos.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    models:
      - name: "SuggestedLemmaQueryResult"
        _change: "add"
        type: "record"
        visibility: "public"
        fields:
          - name: "taskId"
            type: "String"
            description: "Refinement task identifier that was queried"
          - name: "level"
            type: "CefrLevel"
            description: "CEFR level used to rank and filter suggested lemmas"
          - name: "suggestedLemmas"
            type: "List<SuggestedLemma>"
            description: "Suggested lemmas matching the query"
          - name: "message"
            type: "String"
            description: "Functional message explaining empty or partial results"
```

## Expresa rechazos funcionales como excepción de dominio

Algunas consultas deben fallar por razones del negocio, por ejemplo una tarea incompatible o un nivel no resoluble. Modelar esos rechazos en el dominio evita que el CLI tenga que interpretar estados internos o errores genéricos. La excepción conserva el identificador de tarea y la razón para que el adaptador pueda producir una respuesta clara al usuario.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    models:
      - name: "SuggestedLemmaQueryRejectedException"
        _change: "add"
        type: "exception"
        visibility: "public"
        extends: "RuntimeException"
        message: "Suggested lemma query rejected for task %s: %s"
        fields:
          - name: "taskId"
            type: "String"
          - name: "reason"
            type: "String"
```

## Define el puerto público de consulta

La operación de suggested lemmas es una capacidad del dominio, no una extensión accidental del comando. El puerto fija el límite arquitectónico: recibe el reporte, la tarea y la intención de consulta, y devuelve un resultado estable para cualquier adaptador. Declarar el rechazo funcional en la firma hace explícito que la validación pertenece al caso de uso.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    interfaces:
      - name: "SuggestedLemmaQueryService"
        _change: "add"
        stereotype: "port"
        visibility: "public"
        exposes:
          - signature: "query(AuditReport report, RefinementTask task, SuggestedLemmaQuery query): SuggestedLemmaQueryResult"
            throws: ["SuggestedLemmaQueryRejectedException"]
```

## Introduce una fábrica para construir el servicio

El servicio depende de colaboradores internos que no deben exponerse al CLI ni a otros consumidores del puerto. La fábrica proporciona una costura estable para ensamblar la implementación por defecto sin convertir sus dependencias en parte del contrato público. Esto deja abierta la posibilidad de cambiar el motor interno sin renegociar la integración con los adaptadores.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    interfaces:
      - name: "SuggestedLemmaQueryServiceFactory"
        _change: "add"
        stereotype: "factory"
        visibility: "public"
        exposes:
          - signature: "create(): SuggestedLemmaQueryService"
```

## Aísla el motor interno en un paquete dedicado

La consulta combina inferencia de nivel, generación de candidatos y ordenamiento, que son responsabilidades diferentes pero cohesionadas dentro del mismo caso de uso. Ubicarlas en un paquete interno permite evolucionar esas políticas sin ampliar la superficie pública del dominio. La visibilidad interna protege al resto del sistema de depender de pasos intermedios del algoritmo.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    packages:
      - name: "suggestedlemmas"
        _change: "add"
        description: "Hidden engine and collaborators for querying, ranking, and filtering suggested lemmas"
        visibility: "internal"
        interfaces:
          - name: "SuggestedLemmaLevelResolver"
            _change: "add"
            stereotype: "collaborator"
            visibility: "internal"
            exposes:
              - signature: "resolve(AuditReport report, RefinementTask task, Optional<CefrLevel> requestedLevel): CefrLevel"
                throws: ["SuggestedLemmaQueryRejectedException"]
          - name: "SuggestedLemmaCandidateBuilder"
            _change: "add"
            stereotype: "collaborator"
            visibility: "internal"
            exposes:
              - signature: "build(AuditReport report, RefinementTask task, CefrLevel level): List<SuggestedLemma>"
          - name: "SuggestedLemmaRanker"
            _change: "add"
            stereotype: "collaborator"
            visibility: "internal"
            exposes:
              - signature: "rankAndFilter(List<SuggestedLemma> candidates, CefrLevel level, Optional<String> partOfSpeech, Optional<Integer> limit): List<SuggestedLemma>"
```

## Ensambla el servicio por defecto desde colaboradores internos

La implementación por defecto actúa como orquestador del caso de uso y delega las decisiones especializadas en componentes más pequeños. Esta separación facilita probar la consulta completa y, al mismo tiempo, sustituir políticas individuales de nivel, candidatos o ranking. Mantener el servicio como interno refuerza que el punto de entrada soportado es el puerto público.

```architecture
modules:
  - name: "refiner-domain"
    _change: "modify"
    packages:
      - name: "suggestedlemmas"
        _change: "add"
        description: "Hidden engine and collaborators for querying, ranking, and filtering suggested lemmas"
        visibility: "internal"
        implementations:

            requiresInject:

              - name: "candidateBuilder"

              - name: "ranker"

          - name: "DefaultSuggestedLemmaQueryService"
            _change: "add"

                type: "SuggestedLemmaLevelResolver"
              - name: "candidateBuilder"
                type: "SuggestedLemmaCandidateBuilder"
              - name: "ranker"
                type: "SuggestedLemmaRanker"
```

## Añade las políticas internas iniciales

El primer motor necesita implementaciones concretas para resolver nivel, construir candidatos desde diagnósticos y aplicar ranking con filtros. Separarlas desde el inicio evita que el algoritmo quede embebido en una clase monolítica difícil de ajustar cuando cambien las reglas lingüísticas. La elección acepta una estructura un poco más amplia a cambio de mantener cada política reemplazable y verificable.

La fábrica y el adaptador quedan registrados como decisiones explícitas para que el mapa arquitectónico refleje las costuras reales del diseño. Esto ayuda a distinguir el contrato público de la implementación interna y a documentar por qué el CLI no instancia directamente el motor. También facilita que futuras extensiones respeten el mismo límite en lugar de acoplarse a clases internas.

          - name: >-

              KTLEN analyzers, then the report root contains aggregated knowledge-title-length and
              knowledge-instructions-length scores at every hierarchy level
            traceability:

              journey: F-KTLEN-J001
          - name: >-
              Given a course with knowledges whose title weighted length exceeds 28, when AuditEngine.runAudit is
              invoked, then the affected knowledge nodes carry knowledge-title-length scores below 1.0 enabling
              identification of overlong titles
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-KTLEN
              journey: F-KTLEN-J002
          - name: >-
              Given a course with mixed title and instruction lengths, when AuditEngine.runAudit is invoked, then
              per-level scores for knowledge-title-length and knowledge-instructions-length are reported independently
              per AuditNode allowing the user to compare both dimensions
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-KTLEN
              journey: F-KTLEN-J004
          - name: >-
              Given two AuditableCourses with identical content but milestones declared in different orders, when
              AuditEngine.runAudit is invoked on each with the LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer registered, then both
              AuditReports produce the same lemma-recurrence score confirming a deterministic CEFR-ordered traversal
              independent of input declaration order
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-LREC
              rule: F-LREC-R002
          - name: >-
              should aggregate quiz-level sentence-length scores into each KNOWLEDGE node as the simple average of the
              scoring quizzes under it omitting from the average any quiz excluded by F-SLEN-R001 and leaving the
              knowledge score unavailable when no quiz under it has a score
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-SLEN
              rule: F-SLEN-R003
          - name: >-
              should aggregate knowledge-level sentence-length scores into each TOPIC node as the simple average of the
              scoring knowledges under it omitting from the average any knowledge without a score and leaving the topic
              score unavailable when no knowledge under it has a score
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-SLEN
              rule: F-SLEN-R004
          - name: >-
              should aggregate topic-level sentence-length scores into each MILESTONE node as the simple average of the
              scoring topics under it omitting from the average any topic without a score and leaving the level score
              unavailable when no topic under it has a score
            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-SLEN
              rule: F-SLEN-R005
          - name: >-

              course overall score when no milestone has a score

              feature: FEAT-SLEN
              rule: F-SLEN-R008
          - name: >-

            traceability:
              feature: FEAT-SLEN
              rule: F-SLEN-R016

    scope: internal
    packages:
      - name: coca
        description: >-
          COCA frequency bucket distribution analysis. Classifies NLP tokens into frequency bands (K1-K5+), evaluates
          distribution against configurable targets per CEFR level, assesses progression across levels, and generates
          improvement directives.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: FrequencyBand
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: name
                type: String
                description: Band identifier (e.g. K1, K2, K3, K4, K5_PLUS)
              - name: lowerBound
                type: int
                description: Inclusive lower frequency rank bound
              - name: upperBound
                type: int
                description: Inclusive upper frequency rank bound (Integer.MAX_VALUE for open-ended)
          - name: BandConfiguration
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bands
                type: List<FrequencyBand>
                description: Ordered list of frequency bands from most common to least common
              - name: openEnded
                type: boolean
                description: If true, the last band captures all ranks above its lower bound
          - name: AssessmentState
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: OPTIMAL
              - name: ADEQUATE
              - name: DEFICIENT
              - name: EXCESSIVE
          - name: TargetKind
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: AT_LEAST
              - name: AT_MOST
          - name: BucketTarget
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band this target applies to
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Expected percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: kind
                type: TargetKind
                description: Whether the target is a minimum or maximum threshold
          - name: BucketResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Number of tokens classified into this band
              - name: percentage
                type: double
                description: Actual percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Expected percentage for this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Score for this bucket (0.0-1.0) based on proximity to target
              - name: assessment
                type: AssessmentState
                description: Qualitative assessment of this bucket result
          - name: QuarterBucketTargets
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: targets
                type: List<BucketTarget>
                description: Bucket targets for a specific quarter of a level
          - name: QuarterResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: index
                type: int
                description: Quarter index (0-based) within the level
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per band for this quarter
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this quarter (0.0-1.0)
          - name: LevelBucketDistribution
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: levelName
                type: String
                description: CEFR level name (e.g. A1, A2, B1, B2)
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this level (0.0-1.0)
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Overall distribution results per band for this level
              - name: quarterResults
                type: List<QuarterResult>
                description: Quarter-by-quarter breakdown within this level
              - name: topicDistributions
                type: List<TopicBucketDistribution>
                description: Per-topic breakdown within this level
          - name: TopicBucketDistribution
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: topicId
                type: String
                description: Topic identifier
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this topic (0.0-1.0)
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per band for this topic
              - name: topicLabel
                type: String
                description: Human-readable topic name for COCA distribution reports
          - name: ProgressionState
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: ASCENDING
              - name: DESCENDING
              - name: STATIC
              - name: IRREGULAR
          - name: ProgressionExpectation
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band whose progression is being specified
              - name: expectedProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Expected progression pattern across levels for this band
          - name: ProgressionAssessment
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band assessed
              - name: actualProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Observed progression pattern across levels
              - name: expectedProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Expected progression pattern from configuration
              - name: matches
                type: boolean
                description: Whether actual matches expected progression
          - name: ImprovementDirectiveType
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: ENRICH
              - name: REDUCE
          - name: ImprovementDirective
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: type
                type: ImprovementDirectiveType
                description: Whether to enrich or reduce tokens in the target range
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band this directive targets
              - name: levelName
                type: String
                description: The CEFR level this directive applies to
              - name: frequencyRangeFrom
                type: int
                description: Lower bound of the COCA frequency range
              - name: frequencyRangeTo
                type: int
                description: Upper bound of the COCA frequency range
              - name: actualPercentage
                type: double
                description: Current percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Desired percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
          - name: CocaBucketsDistributionResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: levels
                type: List<LevelBucketDistribution>
                description: Per-level distribution results
              - name: progressionAssessments
                type: List<ProgressionAssessment>
                description: Progression assessments across levels for each band
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Weighted overall score across all levels (0.0-1.0)
              - name: improvementDirectives
                type: List<ImprovementDirective>
                description: Actionable improvement directives for levels not meeting targets
          - name: AnalysisStrategy
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: LEVELS
              - name: QUARTERS
          - name: CocaProgressionDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Global COCA distribution analysis score (0.0-1.0)
              - name: progressionAssessments
                type: List<ProgressionAssessment>
                description: Progression evaluation per frequency band across levels
              - name: improvementDirectives
                type: List<ImprovementDirective>
                description: Directives indicating which bands need adjustments in which levels
          - name: CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: totalTokens
                type: int
                description: Total number of classified tokens in this level
              - name: buckets
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per frequency band with count, percentage, target, score and assessment
              - name: quarters
                type: List<QuarterResult>
                description: Distribution results per quarter with index, score and internal buckets
          - name: CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: totalTokens
                type: int
                description: Total number of classified tokens in this topic
              - name: buckets
                type: List<BucketSummary>
                description: Informational distribution summary per band without evaluation against targets
          - name: BucketSummary
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band (e.g., top1k, top2k)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Number of tokens classified into this band
              - name: percentage
                type: double
                description: Percentage of tokens in this band relative to topic total (0.0-1.0)
        interfaces:
          - name: TokenClassifier
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "classify(int frequencyRank,BandConfiguration bandConfig): FrequencyBand"
          - name: ProgressionEvaluator
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: >-
                  evaluate(List<LevelBucketDistribution> levels,List<ProgressionExpectation> expectations):
                  List<ProgressionAssessment>
          - name: ImprovementPlanner
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: >-
                  plan(List<LevelBucketDistribution> levels,BandConfiguration bandConfig,CocaBucketsConfig config):
                  List<ImprovementDirective>
        implementations:
          - name: CocaBucketsAnalyzer
            requiresInject:
              - name: nlpTokenizer
                type: NlpTokenizer
              - name: cocaBucketsConfig
                type: CocaBucketsConfig
              - name: tokenClassifier
                type: TokenClassifier
              - name: progressionEvaluator
                type: ProgressionEvaluator
              - name: improvementPlanner
                type: ImprovementPlanner
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should emit on the COURSE AuditNode a CocaProgressionDiagnosis populated with overallScore
                  progressionAssessments and improvementDirectives reflecting the analyzer outputs at the course level
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R001
              - name: >-
                  should emit on every MILESTONE AuditNode a CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis populated with totalTokens
                  buckets and quarters reflecting the per-level analyzer outputs
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R002
              - name: >-
                  should emit on every TOPIC AuditNode a CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis populated with totalTokens and
                  BucketSummary entries reflecting the informational per-topic distribution
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R003
              - name: >-
                  should NOT emit a coca-buckets diagnosis on any KNOWLEDGE or QUIZ AuditNode confirming the analyzer
                  operates only at course milestone and topic granularity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R004
              - name: >-
                  should make the emitted CocaProgressionDiagnosis CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis and
                  CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis retrievable via the typed CourseDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis
                  LevelDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis and TopicDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis getters on the
                  matching nodes
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R005
              - name: >-
                  should not write any coca-buckets-distribution entry to the untyped metadata map on any AuditNode
                  after the migration to typed diagnoses is complete
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R007
              - name: >-
                  should compute the percentage of tokens in each band as (count-in-band / total-classified) times 100
                  for every level (and quarter when the strategy is quarters) accumulating across all quizzes knowledges
                  and topics in that node
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R005
              - name: >-
                  should classify every token using the frequencyRank already attached by the upstream NLP tokenization
                  step and never call a frequency lookup service from inside the analyzer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R006
              - name: >-
                  should produce one of OPTIMO ADEQUATE DEFICIENTE or EXCESIVO for every band-level pair by comparing
                  the band's actual percentage against the configured target taking optimalRange and adequateRange
                  tolerances into account
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R007
              - name: >-
                  should interpret target directionality as atLeast (OPTIMO when actual >= target - optimalRange
                  ADEQUATE within adequateRange below DEFICIENTE further below no EXCESIVO state) or atMost (mirror
                  semantics above the target with no DEFICIENTE state) according to the kind configured for each band
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R008
              - name: >-
                  should score each band as 1.0 when OPTIMO 0.8 when ADEQUATE and max(0, 0.8 - (|actual-target| -
                  adequateRange) * 0.04) when DEFICIENTE or EXCESIVO using the same distance-from-target formula in both
                  directions
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R010
              - name: >-
                  should compute the score of a quarter as the simple average of the scores of the bands that have a
                  target defined in that quarter ignoring bands without target in that quarter
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R011
              - name: >-
                  should compute the score of a level under strategy LEVELS as the simple average of the scores of the
                  bands with level-level targets and under strategy QUARTERS as a weighted combination of band-level
                  scores quarter-level scores and topic-level scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R012
              - name: >-
                  should compute the overall course-level coca-buckets-distribution score as the simple average of the
                  scores of the CEFR levels that have classified tokens omitting from the average any level without data
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R013
                  journey: F-COCA-J001
              - name: >-
                  should interpolate quarter targets Q2 and Q3 linearly per band using Q1 + (Q4 - Q1) * (1/3) and Q1 +
                  (Q4 - Q1) * (2/3) respectively when running under the QUARTERS strategy
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R015
              - name: >-
                  should propagate the directionality kind of Q1 to the interpolated quarters Q2 and Q3 ignoring any
                  kind declared on Q4 when the two would disagree
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R016
              - name: >-
                  should evaluate every band against the configured level-level targets directly without subdividing the
                  level into quarters when running under the LEVELS strategy
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R019
              - name: >-
                  should compute band scores only at the level and quarter nodes that have configured targets and never
                  publish a band score for KNOWLEDGE or TOPIC nodes regardless of their accumulated counts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R027
              - name: >-
                  should publish on every AuditNode for every band the band name accumulated count and percentage and
                  additionally on nodes with configured targets the target percentage kind band score and evaluation
                  state
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R028
                  journey: F-COCA-J002
                _change: modify
              - name: >-
                  should assign every topic of a CEFR level to exactly one quarter when running under the QUARTERS
                  strategy producing a quarter-to-topic partition that covers all topics of the level with no duplicates
                  and no gaps regardless of the precise rounding algorithm used to balance counts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R017
            implements:
              - ContentAnalyzer
          - name: CocaTokenAccumulationAggregator
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should accumulate token counts per band by summing the band counts of each child node when rolling up
                  the audit tree (quiz to knowledge to topic to level) so a parent's band count equals the sum of its
                  children's band counts and never a simple average of scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R025
              - name: >-
                  should publish on every AuditNode of the hierarchy (knowledge topic level) a percentage distribution
                  per band computed as (accumulated-count / total-classified) times 100 from the counts rolled up at
                  that node
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R026
                  journey: F-COCA-J005
              - name: >-
                  should be selected by the audit engine as the aggregator for the coca-buckets-distribution analyzer
                  demonstrating that the platform supports per-analyzer aggregation strategies and that the default
                  simple-score-average is not used for this analyzer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R029
            implements:
              - ScoreAggregator
          - name: DefaultTokenClassifier
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should place a token with frequencyRank between 1 and 1000 in the top1k band a token between 1001 and
                  2000 in the top2k band a token between 2001 and 3000 in the top3k band and a token with rank 3001 or
                  above in the top4k band
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R001
              - name: >-
                  should treat the top4k band as open so tokens with arbitrarily large frequencyRank (e.g. 3500 and
                  15000) are classified into the same top4k band when the band carries the open flag
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R002
              - name: >-
                  should exclude tokens whose frequencyRank is null from every BucketResult.count and from the
                  totalTokens of the produced CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis and CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis so percentages are
                  computed only over effectively classified tokens
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R004
            implements:
              - TokenClassifier
          - name: DefaultProgressionEvaluator
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should classify the real progression of each band with configured expected progression as ASCENDENTE
                  when only increases between consecutive levels DESCENDENTE when only decreases ESTATICA when no
                  significant changes and IRREGULAR when both increases and decreases occur
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R021
                  journey: F-COCA-J003
              - name: >-
                  should evaluate progression only across CEFR levels that have classified tokens skipping levels
                  without data and falling back to ESTATICA when fewer than two levels have data
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R022
              - name: >-
                  should produce per-band a progression-assessment record with band name expected progression real
                  progression and a boolean indicating whether real matches expected
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R024
              - name: >-
                  should ignore band percentage changes smaller than the configured significance margin when classifying
                  a band's real progression so two consecutive levels whose percentages differ only by a sub-margin
                  amount contribute neither an increase nor a decrease to the progression evaluation
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R023
            implements:
              - ProgressionEvaluator
          - name: DefaultImprovementPlanner
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should emit improvement directives in two categories bucketsToEnrich for bands with DEFICIENTE state
                  (need more tokens of that frequency) and bucketsToReduce for bands with EXCESIVO state (need fewer
                  tokens of that frequency) for every level (and quarter under strategy QUARTERS) where targets are not
                  met
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R030
                  journey: F-COCA-J004
              - name: >-
                  should include in every improvement directive the frequency rank range (from/to) of the affected band
                  so the content creator can look up replacement words within that range and for the open band (top4k)
                  the upper bound is expressed as open-ended
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R031
              - name: >-
                  should emit improvement directives only for bands whose state is DEFICIENTE or EXCESIVO and never for
                  OPTIMO or ADEQUATE so the content creator is not flooded with unactionable advice
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R032
            implements:
              - ImprovementPlanner
      - name: lrec
        description: >-
          Lemma recurrence analysis by spaced repetition. Tracks global word positions across the course, calculates
          mean intervals between consecutive lemma occurrences, classifies exposure status (normal, sub-exposed,
          over-exposed), and produces a course-level recurrence score.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: ExposureStatus
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: NORMAL
                type: String
              - name: SUB_EXPOSED
                type: String
              - name: OVER_EXPOSED
                type: String
          - name: LemmaStats
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemma
                type: String
                description: Lemmatized form of the word
              - name: pos
                type: String
                description: Predominant POS tag (NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Total number of occurrences in the course
              - name: meanInterval
                type: double
                description: Mean interval between consecutive occurrences (in global positions)
              - name: stdDevInterval
                type: double
                description: Population standard deviation of intervals
              - name: exposureStatus
                type: ExposureStatus
                description: "Exposure classification: NORMAL, SUB_EXPOSED, or OVER_EXPOSED"
              - name: occurrencePositions
                type: List<Integer>
                description: All global positions where this lemma appears
          - name: ExposureSummary
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: normalCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with NORMAL exposure
              - name: subExposedCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with SUB_EXPOSED exposure
              - name: overExposedCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with OVER_EXPOSED exposure
          - name: LemmaRecurrenceResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemmaStats
                type: List<LemmaStats>
                description: Per-lemma statistics, ordered by count descending
              - name: exposureSummary
                type: ExposureSummary
                description: Aggregate counts by exposure status
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Proportion of lemmas with NORMAL exposure (0.0 to 1.0)
        interfaces:
          - name: IntervalCalculator
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "calculateMeanInterval(List<Integer> positions): double"
              - signature: "calculateStdDevInterval(List<Integer> positions,double meanInterval): double"
          - name: ExposureClassifier
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "classify(double meanInterval,LemmaRecurrenceConfig config): ExposureStatus"
        implementations:
          - name: LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer
            requiresInject:
              - name: contentWordFilter
                type: ContentWordFilter
              - name: lemmaRecurrenceConfig
                type: LemmaRecurrenceConfig
              - name: intervalCalculator
                type: IntervalCalculator
              - name: exposureClassifier
                type: ExposureClassifier
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: Given a LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer, when getName is called, then returns lemma-recurrence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R015
              - name: Given a LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer, when getTarget is called, then returns COURSE
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R013
              - name: >-
                  should assign a globally sequential position counter incremented by one per token traversed across
                  every quiz in the course
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R001
              - name: >-
                  should register each content-word token under its lemma key in the lemma-positions map preserving the
                  global position and grouping inflected forms by their lemmatized form
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R004
              - name: >-
                  should restrict the analysed lemmas to the top N most frequent ones according to the configured top
                  parameter discarding the least frequent lemmas beyond that limit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R005
              - name: >-
                  should skip from the per-lemma interval calculation any lemma whose registered position list has fewer
                  than two entries
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R006
              - name: >-
                  should classify each analysed lemma as NORMAL when overExposed < meanInterval <= subExposed as
                  OVER_EXPOSED when meanInterval <= overExposed and as SUB_EXPOSED when meanInterval > subExposed using
                  the configured thresholds
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R008
              - name: >-
                  should produce an ExposureSummary whose normalCount plus subExposedCount plus overExposedCount equals
                  the total count of lemmas analysed
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R009
              - name: >-
                  should compute the overall lemma-recurrence score as normalCount divided by totalCount rounded to two
                  decimals and return 0.0 when totalCount is zero
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R010
              - name: >-
                  should produce identical overall score and exposure classification when two analysed lemmas share the
                  same meanInterval but differ in stdDevInterval confirming stdDev is informative only
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R011
              - name: >-
                  should populate every LemmaStats entry with lemma pos count meanInterval stdDevInterval exposureStatus
                  and occurrencePositions matching the data captured for that lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R012
            implements:
              - ContentAnalyzer
          - name: DefaultContentWordFilter
            tests:
              - name: Given a NOUN token, when isContentWord is called, then returns true
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:nounToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: nounToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: cat
                      lemma: cat
                      posTag: NOUN
                      frequencyRank: 100
                      isStop: false
                      isPunct: false
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: true
              - name: Given a VERB token, when isContentWord is called, then returns true
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:verbToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: verbToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: running
                      lemma: run
                      posTag: VERB
                      frequencyRank: 50
                      isStop: false
                      isPunct: false
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: true
              - name: Given an ADJ token, when isContentWord is called, then returns true
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:adjToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: adjToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: big
                      lemma: big
                      posTag: ADJ
                      frequencyRank: 200
                      isStop: false
                      isPunct: false
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: true
              - name: Given an ADV token, when isContentWord is called, then returns true
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:advToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: advToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: quickly
                      lemma: quickly
                      posTag: ADV
                      frequencyRank: 300
                      isStop: false
                      isPunct: false
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: true
              - name: Given a DET token, when isContentWord is called, then returns false
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:detToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: detToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: the
                      lemma: the
                      posTag: DET
                      frequencyRank: 1
                      isStop: true
                      isPunct: false
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: false
              - name: Given a PUNCT token, when isContentWord is called, then returns false
                target: DefaultContentWordFilter
                invoke:
                  method: isContentWord
                  args:
                    - ref:punctToken
                fixtures:
                  - id: punctToken
                    type: NlpToken
                    construct:
                      text: .
                      lemma: .
                      posTag: PUNCT
                      frequencyRank: 0
                      isStop: false
                      isPunct: true
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R003
                assert:
                  returns: false
            visibility: public
            implements:
              - ContentWordFilter
          - name: DefaultIntervalCalculator
            tests:
              - name: Given positions [10, 110], when calculateMeanInterval is called, then returns 100.0
                target: DefaultIntervalCalculator
                invoke:
                  method: calculateMeanInterval
                  args:
                    - "[10, 110]"
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R007
                assert:
                  returns: 100
              - name: Given positions [0, 100, 200, 300], when calculateMeanInterval is called, then returns 100.0
                target: DefaultIntervalCalculator
                invoke:
                  method: calculateMeanInterval
                  args:
                    - "[0, 100, 200, 300]"
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R007
                assert:
                  returns: 100
              - name: Given positions [10, 110] and mean 100.0, when calculateStdDevInterval is called, then returns 0.0
                target: DefaultIntervalCalculator
                invoke:
                  method: calculateStdDevInterval
                  args:
                    - "[10, 110]"
                    - 100
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R007
                assert:
                  returns: 0
              - name: >-
                  Given positions [0, 100, 200, 300] and mean 100.0, when calculateStdDevInterval is called, then
                  returns 0.0
                target: DefaultIntervalCalculator
                invoke:
                  method: calculateStdDevInterval
                  args:
                    - "[0, 100, 200, 300]"
                    - 100
                type: unit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R007
                assert:
                  returns: 0
            visibility: public
            implements:
              - IntervalCalculator
          - name: DefaultExposureClassifier
            visibility: public
            implements:
              - ExposureClassifier
      - name: labs
        description: >-
          Lemma absence analysis by CEFR level. Compares course vocabulary against the EVP catalog to detect absent,
          misplaced, or scattered lemmas. Classifies absence type, assigns priority by COCA frequency, computes
          per-level metrics, and generates actionable recommendations.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: AbsenceType
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: COMPLETELY_ABSENT
                type: double
                description: Lemma not found in any level — impact 1.0
              - name: APPEARS_TOO_LATE
                type: double
                description: Lemma only in levels after expected — impact 0.8
              - name: APPEARS_TOO_EARLY
                type: double
                description: Lemma found in at least one level before expected — impact 0.6
          - name: PriorityLevel
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: HIGH
              - name: MEDIUM
              - name: LOW
          - name: LemmaAndPos
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemma
                type: String
                description: Base form of the word
              - name: pos
                type: String
                description: Part-of-speech tag
          - name: AbsentLemma
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemmaAndPos
                type: LemmaAndPos
                description: The absent lemma-POS pair
              - name: expectedLevel
                type: CefrLevel
                description: CEFR level where the lemma is expected per EVP
              - name: absenceType
                type: AbsenceType
                description: Classification of the absence
              - name: presentInLevels
                type: List<CefrLevel>
                description: Levels where the lemma does appear (may be empty)
              - name: priorityLevel
                type: PriorityLevel
                description: Priority based on COCA frequency rank
              - name: cocaRank
                type: Integer
                description: COCA frequency ranking (null if unavailable)
              - name: semanticCategory
                type: String
                description: Semantic topic from EVP catalog (nullable)
          - name: AbsenceAssessment
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: OPTIMAL
                description: All levels within tolerance thresholds
              - name: ACCEPTABLE
                description: Some levels exceed thresholds but no critical level (A1/A2) exceeds
              - name: NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT
                description: At least one critical level (A1/A2) exceeds its threshold
          - name: LevelAbsenceMetrics
            type: record
            fields:
