    scope: internal
    packages:
      - name: coca
        description: >-
          COCA frequency bucket distribution analysis. Classifies NLP tokens into frequency bands (K1-K5+), evaluates
          distribution against configurable targets per CEFR level, assesses progression across levels, and generates
          improvement directives.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: FrequencyBand
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: name
                type: String
                description: Band identifier (e.g. K1, K2, K3, K4, K5_PLUS)
              - name: lowerBound
                type: int
                description: Inclusive lower frequency rank bound
              - name: upperBound
                type: int
                description: Inclusive upper frequency rank bound (Integer.MAX_VALUE for open-ended)
          - name: BandConfiguration
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bands
                type: List<FrequencyBand>
                description: Ordered list of frequency bands from most common to least common
              - name: openEnded
                type: boolean
                description: If true, the last band captures all ranks above its lower bound
          - name: AssessmentState
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: OPTIMAL
              - name: ADEQUATE
              - name: DEFICIENT
              - name: EXCESSIVE
          - name: TargetKind
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: AT_LEAST
              - name: AT_MOST
          - name: BucketTarget
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band this target applies to
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Expected percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: kind
                type: TargetKind
                description: Whether the target is a minimum or maximum threshold
          - name: BucketResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Number of tokens classified into this band
              - name: percentage
                type: double
                description: Actual percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Expected percentage for this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Score for this bucket (0.0-1.0) based on proximity to target
              - name: assessment
                type: AssessmentState
                description: Qualitative assessment of this bucket result
          - name: QuarterBucketTargets
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: targets
                type: List<BucketTarget>
                description: Bucket targets for a specific quarter of a level
          - name: QuarterResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: index
                type: int
                description: Quarter index (0-based) within the level
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per band for this quarter
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this quarter (0.0-1.0)
          - name: LevelBucketDistribution
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: levelName
                type: String
                description: CEFR level name (e.g. A1, A2, B1, B2)
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this level (0.0-1.0)
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Overall distribution results per band for this level
              - name: quarterResults
                type: List<QuarterResult>
                description: Quarter-by-quarter breakdown within this level
              - name: topicDistributions
                type: List<TopicBucketDistribution>
                description: Per-topic breakdown within this level
          - name: TopicBucketDistribution
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: topicId
                type: String
                description: Topic identifier
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: Aggregated score for this topic (0.0-1.0)
              - name: bucketResults
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per band for this topic
              - name: topicLabel
                type: String
                description: Human-readable topic name for COCA distribution reports
          - name: ProgressionState
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: ASCENDING
              - name: DESCENDING
              - name: STATIC
              - name: IRREGULAR
          - name: ProgressionExpectation
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band whose progression is being specified
              - name: expectedProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Expected progression pattern across levels for this band
          - name: ProgressionAssessment
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band assessed
              - name: actualProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Observed progression pattern across levels
              - name: expectedProgression
                type: ProgressionState
                description: Expected progression pattern from configuration
              - name: matches
                type: boolean
                description: Whether actual matches expected progression
          - name: ImprovementDirectiveType
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: ENRICH
              - name: REDUCE
          - name: ImprovementDirective
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: type
                type: ImprovementDirectiveType
                description: Whether to enrich or reduce tokens in the target range
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: The frequency band this directive targets
              - name: levelName
                type: String
                description: The CEFR level this directive applies to
              - name: frequencyRangeFrom
                type: int
                description: Lower bound of the COCA frequency range
              - name: frequencyRangeTo
                type: int
                description: Upper bound of the COCA frequency range
              - name: actualPercentage
                type: double
                description: Current percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
              - name: targetPercentage
                type: double
                description: Desired percentage of tokens in this band (0.0-1.0)
          - name: CocaBucketsDistributionResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: levels
                type: List<LevelBucketDistribution>
                description: Per-level distribution results
              - name: progressionAssessments
                type: List<ProgressionAssessment>
                description: Progression assessments across levels for each band
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Weighted overall score across all levels (0.0-1.0)
              - name: improvementDirectives
                type: List<ImprovementDirective>
                description: Actionable improvement directives for levels not meeting targets
          - name: AnalysisStrategy
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: LEVELS
              - name: QUARTERS
          - name: CocaProgressionDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Global COCA distribution analysis score (0.0-1.0)
              - name: progressionAssessments
                type: List<ProgressionAssessment>
                description: Progression evaluation per frequency band across levels
              - name: improvementDirectives
                type: List<ImprovementDirective>
                description: Directives indicating which bands need adjustments in which levels
          - name: CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: totalTokens
                type: int
                description: Total number of classified tokens in this level
              - name: buckets
                type: List<BucketResult>
                description: Distribution results per frequency band with count, percentage, target, score and assessment
              - name: quarters
                type: List<QuarterResult>
                description: Distribution results per quarter with index, score and internal buckets
          - name: CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: totalTokens
                type: int
                description: Total number of classified tokens in this topic
              - name: buckets
                type: List<BucketSummary>
                description: Informational distribution summary per band without evaluation against targets
          - name: BucketSummary
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: bandName
                type: String
                description: Name of the frequency band (e.g., top1k, top2k)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Number of tokens classified into this band
              - name: percentage
                type: double
                description: Percentage of tokens in this band relative to topic total (0.0-1.0)
        interfaces:
          - name: TokenClassifier
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "classify(int frequencyRank,BandConfiguration bandConfig): FrequencyBand"
          - name: ProgressionEvaluator
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: >-
                  evaluate(List<LevelBucketDistribution> levels,List<ProgressionExpectation> expectations):
                  List<ProgressionAssessment>
          - name: ImprovementPlanner
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: >-
                  plan(List<LevelBucketDistribution> levels,BandConfiguration bandConfig,CocaBucketsConfig config):
                  List<ImprovementDirective>
        implementations:
          - name: CocaBucketsAnalyzer
            requiresInject:
              - name: nlpTokenizer
                type: NlpTokenizer
              - name: cocaBucketsConfig
                type: CocaBucketsConfig
              - name: tokenClassifier
                type: TokenClassifier
              - name: progressionEvaluator
                type: ProgressionEvaluator
              - name: improvementPlanner
                type: ImprovementPlanner
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should emit on the COURSE AuditNode a CocaProgressionDiagnosis populated with overallScore
                  progressionAssessments and improvementDirectives reflecting the analyzer outputs at the course level
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R001
              - name: >-
                  should emit on every MILESTONE AuditNode a CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis populated with totalTokens
                  buckets and quarters reflecting the per-level analyzer outputs
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R002
              - name: >-
                  should emit on every TOPIC AuditNode a CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis populated with totalTokens and
                  BucketSummary entries reflecting the informational per-topic distribution
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R003
              - name: >-
                  should NOT emit a coca-buckets diagnosis on any KNOWLEDGE or QUIZ AuditNode confirming the analyzer
                  operates only at course milestone and topic granularity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R004
              - name: >-
                  should make the emitted CocaProgressionDiagnosis CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis and
                  CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis retrievable via the typed CourseDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis
                  LevelDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis and TopicDiagnoses.getCocaBucketsDiagnosis getters on the
                  matching nodes
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R005
              - name: >-
                  should not write any coca-buckets-distribution entry to the untyped metadata map on any AuditNode
                  after the migration to typed diagnoses is complete
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DCOCA
                  rule: F-DCOCA-R007
              - name: >-
                  should compute the percentage of tokens in each band as (count-in-band / total-classified) times 100
                  for every level (and quarter when the strategy is quarters) accumulating across all quizzes knowledges
                  and topics in that node
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R005
              - name: >-
                  should classify every token using the frequencyRank already attached by the upstream NLP tokenization
                  step and never call a frequency lookup service from inside the analyzer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R006
              - name: >-
                  should produce one of OPTIMO ADEQUATE DEFICIENTE or EXCESIVO for every band-level pair by comparing
                  the band's actual percentage against the configured target taking optimalRange and adequateRange
                  tolerances into account
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R007
              - name: >-
                  should interpret target directionality as atLeast (OPTIMO when actual >= target - optimalRange
                  ADEQUATE within adequateRange below DEFICIENTE further below no EXCESIVO state) or atMost (mirror
                  semantics above the target with no DEFICIENTE state) according to the kind configured for each band
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R008
              - name: >-
                  should score each band as 1.0 when OPTIMO 0.8 when ADEQUATE and max(0, 0.8 - (|actual-target| -
                  adequateRange) * 0.04) when DEFICIENTE or EXCESIVO using the same distance-from-target formula in both
                  directions
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R010
              - name: >-
                  should compute the score of a quarter as the simple average of the scores of the bands that have a
                  target defined in that quarter ignoring bands without target in that quarter
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R011
              - name: >-
                  should compute the score of a level under strategy LEVELS as the simple average of the scores of the
                  bands with level-level targets and under strategy QUARTERS as a weighted combination of band-level
                  scores quarter-level scores and topic-level scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R012
              - name: >-
                  should compute the overall course-level coca-buckets-distribution score as the simple average of the
                  scores of the CEFR levels that have classified tokens omitting from the average any level without data
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R013
                  journey: F-COCA-J001
              - name: >-
                  should interpolate quarter targets Q2 and Q3 linearly per band using Q1 + (Q4 - Q1) * (1/3) and Q1 +
                  (Q4 - Q1) * (2/3) respectively when running under the QUARTERS strategy
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R015
              - name: >-
                  should propagate the directionality kind of Q1 to the interpolated quarters Q2 and Q3 ignoring any
                  kind declared on Q4 when the two would disagree
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R016
              - name: >-
                  should evaluate every band against the configured level-level targets directly without subdividing the
                  level into quarters when running under the LEVELS strategy
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R019
              - name: >-
                  should compute band scores only at the level and quarter nodes that have configured targets and never
                  publish a band score for KNOWLEDGE or TOPIC nodes regardless of their accumulated counts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R027
              - name: >-
                  should publish on every AuditNode for every band the band name accumulated count and percentage and
                  additionally on nodes with configured targets the target percentage kind band score and evaluation
                  state
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R028
                  journey: F-COCA-J002
                _change: modify
              - name: >-
                  should assign every topic of a CEFR level to exactly one quarter when running under the QUARTERS
                  strategy producing a quarter-to-topic partition that covers all topics of the level with no duplicates
                  and no gaps regardless of the precise rounding algorithm used to balance counts
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R017
            implements:
              - ContentAnalyzer
          - name: CocaTokenAccumulationAggregator
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should accumulate token counts per band by summing the band counts of each child node when rolling up
                  the audit tree (quiz to knowledge to topic to level) so a parent's band count equals the sum of its
                  children's band counts and never a simple average of scores
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R025
              - name: >-
                  should publish on every AuditNode of the hierarchy (knowledge topic level) a percentage distribution
                  per band computed as (accumulated-count / total-classified) times 100 from the counts rolled up at
                  that node
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R026
                  journey: F-COCA-J005
              - name: >-
                  should be selected by the audit engine as the aggregator for the coca-buckets-distribution analyzer
                  demonstrating that the platform supports per-analyzer aggregation strategies and that the default
                  simple-score-average is not used for this analyzer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R029
            implements:
              - ScoreAggregator
          - name: DefaultTokenClassifier
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should place a token with frequencyRank between 1 and 1000 in the top1k band a token between 1001 and
                  2000 in the top2k band a token between 2001 and 3000 in the top3k band and a token with rank 3001 or
                  above in the top4k band
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R001
              - name: >-
                  should treat the top4k band as open so tokens with arbitrarily large frequencyRank (e.g. 3500 and
                  15000) are classified into the same top4k band when the band carries the open flag
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R002
              - name: >-
                  should exclude tokens whose frequencyRank is null from every BucketResult.count and from the
                  totalTokens of the produced CocaBucketsLevelDiagnosis and CocaBucketsTopicDiagnosis so percentages are
                  computed only over effectively classified tokens
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R004
            implements:
              - TokenClassifier
          - name: DefaultProgressionEvaluator
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  should classify the real progression of each band with configured expected progression as ASCENDENTE
                  when only increases between consecutive levels DESCENDENTE when only decreases ESTATICA when no
                  significant changes and IRREGULAR when both increases and decreases occur
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-COCA
                  rule: F-COCA-R021

      - name: lrec
        description: >-
          Lemma recurrence analysis by spaced repetition. Tracks global word positions across the course, calculates
          mean intervals between consecutive lemma occurrences, classifies exposure status (normal, sub-exposed,
          over-exposed), and produces a course-level recurrence score.
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: ExposureStatus
            type: enum
            fields:
              - name: NORMAL
                type: String
              - name: SUB_EXPOSED
                type: String
              - name: OVER_EXPOSED
                type: String
          - name: LemmaStats
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemma
                type: String
                description: Lemmatized form of the word
              - name: pos
                type: String
                description: Predominant POS tag (NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Total number of occurrences in the course
              - name: meanInterval
                type: double
                description: Mean interval between consecutive occurrences (in global positions)
              - name: stdDevInterval
                type: double
                description: Population standard deviation of intervals
              - name: exposureStatus
                type: ExposureStatus
                description: "Exposure classification: NORMAL, SUB_EXPOSED, or OVER_EXPOSED"
              - name: occurrencePositions
                type: List<Integer>
                description: All global positions where this lemma appears
          - name: ExposureSummary
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: normalCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with NORMAL exposure
              - name: subExposedCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with SUB_EXPOSED exposure
              - name: overExposedCount
                type: int
                description: Count of lemmas with OVER_EXPOSED exposure
          - name: LemmaRecurrenceResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemmaStats
                type: List<LemmaStats>
                description: Per-lemma statistics, ordered by count descending
              - name: exposureSummary
                type: ExposureSummary
                description: Aggregate counts by exposure status
              - name: overallScore
                type: double
                description: Proportion of lemmas with NORMAL exposure (0.0 to 1.0)
        interfaces:
          - name: IntervalCalculator
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "calculateMeanInterval(List<Integer> positions): double"
              - signature: "calculateStdDevInterval(List<Integer> positions,double meanInterval): double"
          - name: ExposureClassifier
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "classify(double meanInterval,LemmaRecurrenceConfig config): ExposureStatus"
        implementations:
          - name: LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer
            requiresInject:
              - name: contentWordFilter
                type: ContentWordFilter
              - name: lemmaRecurrenceConfig
                type: LemmaRecurrenceConfig
              - name: intervalCalculator
                type: IntervalCalculator
              - name: exposureClassifier
                type: ExposureClassifier
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: Given a LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer, when getName is called, then returns lemma-recurrence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R015
              - name: Given a LemmaRecurrenceAnalyzer, when getTarget is called, then returns COURSE
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R013
              - name: >-
                  should assign a globally sequential position counter incremented by one per token traversed across
                  every quiz in the course
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R001
              - name: >-
                  should register each content-word token under its lemma key in the lemma-positions map preserving the
                  global position and grouping inflected forms by their lemmatized form
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R004
              - name: >-
                  should restrict the analysed lemmas to the top N most frequent ones according to the configured top
                  parameter discarding the least frequent lemmas beyond that limit
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R005
              - name: >-
                  should skip from the per-lemma interval calculation any lemma whose registered position list has fewer
                  than two entries
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R006
              - name: >-
                  should classify each analysed lemma as NORMAL when overExposed < meanInterval <= subExposed as
                  OVER_EXPOSED when meanInterval <= overExposed and as SUB_EXPOSED when meanInterval > subExposed using
                  the configured thresholds
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R008
              - name: >-
                  should produce an ExposureSummary whose normalCount plus subExposedCount plus overExposedCount equals
                  the total count of lemmas analysed
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R009
              - name: >-
                  should compute the overall lemma-recurrence score as normalCount divided by totalCount rounded to two
                  decimals and return 0.0 when totalCount is zero
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R010
              - name: >-

                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R011
              - name: >-
                  should populate every LemmaStats entry with lemma pos count meanInterval stdDevInterval exposureStatus
                  and occurrencePositions matching the data captured for that lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LREC
                  rule: F-LREC-R012

      - name: labs
        description: >-

          misplaced, or scattered lemmas. Classifies absence type, assigns priority by COCA frequency, computes
          per-level metrics, and generates actionable recommendations.
        visibility: internal
        models:

            fields:

                description: Base form of the word
              - name: pos
                type: String

            fields:

                type: LemmaAndPos
                description: The absent lemma-POS pair

              - name: absenceType
                type: AbsenceType

      - name: lemmacount
        description: >-
          Conteo de repeticiones de lemas content-word por oraciones distintas en todo el curso. Asigna un nivel CEFR a
          cada lema con la cadena EVP -> NLP -> 'no asignado', calcula score por lema (min(count/N, 1.0)), agrega por
          nivel CEFR (promedio simple) y por curso (promedio simple de niveles).
        visibility: internal
        models:
          - name: LemmaCountStats
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemmaAndPos
                type: LemmaAndPos
                description: Lema content-word con su POS (par identificador segun R002)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Numero de oraciones distintas del curso que contienen el lema (R004, R005)
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: "Score del lema: min(count/N, 1.0) (R006)"
              - name: assignedLevel
                type: Optional<CefrLevel>
                description: Nivel CEFR asignado por la cadena R009 -> R010; vacio si el lema cae al grupo 'no asignado' (R011)
          - name: LevelLemmaCountResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: level
                type: CefrLevel
                description: Nivel CEFR cuyo score se reporta
              - name: score
                type: double
                description: "Score del nivel: promedio simple de los scores de sus lemas (R012)"
              - name: totalLemmas
                type: int
                description: Total de lemas evaluados asignados a este nivel (R017)
              - name: subExposedLemmas
                type: List<LemmaCountStats>
                description: Lemas del nivel con score < 1.0 (R017); ordenados por count ascendente para priorizar
          - name: UnassignedLemmaEntry
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: lemmaAndPos
                type: LemmaAndPos
                description: Lema sin nivel CEFR asignado por ninguna fuente (R011)
              - name: count
                type: int
                description: Conteo de oraciones distintas con el lema (R018); no se calcula score
          - name: LemmaCountResult
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: thresholdN
                type: int
                description: Umbral N usado para calcular los scores (R016)
              - name: courseScore
                type: Optional<Double>
                description: >-
                  Score global del curso: promedio simple de los scores de los niveles CEFR (R013, R015). Vacio si
                  ningun nivel tiene score asignable.
              - name: levels
                type: List<LevelLemmaCountResult>
                description: Detalle por nivel CEFR con score (R017). Niveles sin lemas asignados no aparecen (R012).
              - name: unassigned
                type: List<UnassignedLemmaEntry>
                description: >-
                  Lemas que no pudieron clasificarse en ningun nivel CEFR (R011, R018). Informativos: no entran al score
                  del curso (R014).
          - name: LemmaCountCourseDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: result
                type: LemmaCountResult
                description: "Resultado consolidado del analisis: score global, N usado, detalle por nivel y lemas no asignados."
          - name: LemmaCountLevelDiagnosis
            type: record
            fields:
              - name: levelResult
                type: LevelLemmaCountResult
                description: Resultado de este nivel CEFR concreto (score, total de lemas, sub-expuestos).
        interfaces:
          - name: LemmaCefrLevelResolver
            stereotype: port
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "resolve(LemmaAndPos lemmaAndPos, Optional<CefrLevel> nlpCefr): Optional<CefrLevel>"
        implementations:
          - name: EvpThenNlpLemmaCefrLevelResolver
            requiresInject:
              - name: evpCatalogPort
                type: EvpCatalogPort
                description: Fuente primaria de nivel CEFR (R009).
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: should return EVP level when EVP catalog contains the lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R009
              - name: should query EVP catalog by the lemma-and-POS pair as composite identity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R009
              - name: should return empty when EVP catalog has no entry and no other source provides CEFR
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R011
              - name: should return NLP CEFR hint when EVP catalog has no entry for the lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R010
              - name: should prefer EVP level over NLP CEFR hint when EVP catalog also contains the lemma
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-LCOUNT
                  rule: F-LCOUNT-R010
            implements:
              - LemmaCefrLevelResolver
          - name: LemmaCountAnalyzer
            requiresInject:

  - name: course-domain
    description: >-
      Domain module for course structure. Contains entity models representing the 5-level hierarchy (Course > ROOT >
      Milestone > Topic > Knowledge > QuizTemplate), ports for persistence and validation, and domain exceptions. All
      models are Java records with defensive copying. This module has no infrastructure dependencies.
    models:
      - name: NodeKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: ROOT
          - name: MILESTONE
          - name: TOPIC
          - name: KNOWLEDGE
      - name: SentencePartKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: TEXT
          - name: CLOZE
      - name: CourseEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: title
            type: String
            description: Course name, e.g. english-course
          - name: knowledgeIds
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered list of all knowledge IDs in the course (R002)
          - name: root
            type: RootNodeEntity
            description: Explicit ROOT node (R001)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
      - name: RootNodeEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Always root
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always ROOT
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Always empty string
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered milestone IDs defining milestone order (R002/R013)
          - name: milestones
            type: List<MilestoneEntity>
            description: Resolved milestone entities in order
      - name: MilestoneEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always MILESTONE
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. A1, B2
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the ROOT node id (R008)
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered topic IDs defining topic order (R002/R013)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within course, 1-based, derived from ROOT children (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: topics
            type: List<TopicEntity>
            description: Resolved topic entities in order
      - name: TopicEntity
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always TOPIC
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. Present Simple
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the parent milestone id (R008)
          - name: children
            type: List<String>
            description: Always null in current data, preserved for idempotency (R010)
          - name: ruleIds
            type: List<String>
            description: Ordered knowledge IDs defining knowledge order (R002/R013)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within milestone, 1-based, derived from milestone children (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: knowledges
            type: List<KnowledgeEntity>
            description: Resolved knowledge entities in order
      - name: KnowledgeEntity
        type: record
        fields:

            type: String
            description: MongoDB ObjectId as 24-char hex string
          - name: code
            type: String
            description: Entity code, currently matches id
          - name: kind
            type: NodeKind
            description: Always KNOWLEDGE
          - name: label
            type: String
            description: Visible name, e.g. Affirmative sentences in the present simple
          - name: oldId
            type: String
            description: Legacy UUID identifier
          - name: parentId
            type: String
            description: References the parent topic id (R008)
          - name: isRule
            type: boolean
            description: Always true in current data
          - name: instructions
            type: String
            description: Exercise instructions in Spanish, may be null in exceptional cases (R009)
          - name: order
            type: int
            description: Ordinal position within topic, 1-based, derived from topic ruleIds (R013)
          - name: slug
            type: String
            description: Directory name on disk, preserved for idempotency (R003/R016)
          - name: quizTemplates

    scope: internal
    packages:
      - name: quizsentence
        description: >-
          Public contract of the quizSentence DSL. Exposes the converter service and the domain exceptions raised when
          the DSL grammar or the sentenceParts convention is violated. The conversion engine itself is hidden in the
          sibling 'quizsentenceengine' internal package (Public Port, Hidden Adapter).
        visibility: public
        models:
          - name: QuizSentenceSerializationException
            type: exception
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: String
                description: Human-readable cause (R013, R024).
              - name: position
                type: String
                description: Index of the offending sentencePart or 'n/a'.
            message: "No es posible serializar a quizSentence: %s (posicion %s)"
            extends: RuntimeException
          - name: QuizSentenceParseException
            type: exception
            fields:
              - name: reason
                type: String
                description: Human-readable cause (R016, R024).
              - name: position
                type: int
                description: Character offset in the input where the grammar violation was detected.
            message: "No es posible parsear el quizSentence: %s (posicion %d)"
            extends: RuntimeException
        interfaces:
          - name: QuizSentenceConverter
            stereotype: service
            sealed: false
            exposes:
              - signature: "serialize(FormEntity form): String"
              - signature: "parse(String quizSentence): FormEntity"
              - signature: "toPlainSentences(FormEntity form): List<String>"
            visibility: public
      - name: quizsentenceengine
        description: >-
          Internal engine implementing the quizSentence DSL conversions. The public class DefaultQuizSentenceConverter
          is instantiated once by the composition root (audit-cli bootstrap); all collaborators (QuizSentenceSerializer,
          QuizSentenceParser, PlainSentenceDeriver, WhitespaceNormalizer) stay package-private so external modules
          cannot bypass the port.
        visibility: internal
        implementations:
          - name: DefaultQuizSentenceConverter
            requiresInject:
              - name: serializer
                type: QuizSentenceSerializer
              - name: parser
                type: QuizSentenceParser
              - name: plainDeriver
                type: PlainSentenceDeriver
            visibility: public
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: should treat multi-entry options and pipe-splits as equivalent variants of the same answer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R001
              - name: should treat the pipe character as separator of equivalent variants inside an options entry
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R002
              - name: should fail atomically when a TEXT part has options populated
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R003
              - name: should fail atomically when a CLOZE part has null or empty options
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R004
              - name: should reject an underscore run of length other than four as a blank
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R005
              - name: should reject a blank that is not followed by an answer block in brackets
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R006
              - name: should recognize parenthesized segments as pedagogical hints inside plain-text positions
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R007
              - name: should reject a quizSentence that does not alternate text and blank+block
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R008
              - name: should fail explicitly when reserved characters appear unescaped in TEXT content
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R009
              - name: should emit a single canonical space between text and DSL markers on serialize
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R010
              - name: should tolerate runs of whitespace on parse and normalize them
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R010
              - name: should serialize each TEXT preserving its hints with canonical whitespace
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R011
              - name: should serialize each CLOZE as four underscores followed by bracketed pipe-joined variants
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R012
              - name: should fail atomically when serializing an invalid FormEntity without producing partial output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R013
              - name: should reconstruct alternating TEXT and CLOZE parts by scanning blank+block occurrences
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R014
              - name: should preserve hints inside the reconstructed TEXT text field and not extract them to the model
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R015
              - name: should fail atomically when parsing a malformed quizSentence without producing partial output
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R016
              - name: should return a list with one plain sentence per equivalent variant of the answer
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R017
              - name: should place the first sub-variant of the first options entry at index 0 as the canonical variant
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R018
              - name: should strip pedagogical hints from every emitted plain sentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R019
              - name: should normalize whitespace in every emitted plain sentence after hint stripping
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R019
              - name: >-
                  should produce the same plain sentences list whether derived directly from sentenceParts or via
                  quizSentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R020
              - name: should fail atomically when toPlainSentences is called on an invalid FormEntity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R024
              - name: >-
                  should preserve semantics on round-trip sentenceParts to quizSentence to sentenceParts under
                  whitespace-normalized equivalence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R021
              - name: >-
                  should preserve the quizSentence string on round-trip through sentenceParts under
                  whitespace-normalized equivalence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R022
              - name: should expose only the three forward conversions and no inverse reconstruction from a plain sentence
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R023
              - name: should round-trip every real CLOZE in db english-course quizzes json fixtures without error
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R028
              - name: should be consumable as a public course-domain service from another module
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-QSENT
                  rule: F-QSENT-R025
              - name: >-
                  should keep toPlainSentences exposed as a public converter operation that derives the same canonical
                  list from a FormEntity
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-DBSENT
                  rule: F-DBSENT-R003
            implements:
              - QuizSentenceConverter
          - name: QuizSentenceSerializer
          - name: QuizSentenceParser
          - name: PlainSentenceDeriver
            requiresInject:
              - name: whitespaceNormalizer
                type: WhitespaceNormalizer
                description: >-
                  Helper de normalizacion de whitespace (collapse runs, trim) usado al final de buildSentenceFromParts
                  para cumplir R019 sobre la oracion derivada.
          - name: WhitespaceNormalizer
  - name: refiner-domain
    description: Refinement engine
    dependsOn:
      - audit-domain
    models:
      - name: DiagnosisKind
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: SENTENCE_LENGTH
          - name: LEMMA_ABSENCE
          - name: COCA_BUCKETS
          - name: LEMMA_RECURRENCE
          - name: KNOWLEDGE_TITLE_LENGTH
          - name: KNOWLEDGE_INSTRUCTIONS_LENGTH
      - name: RefinementTaskStatus
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: PENDING
          - name: COMPLETED
          - name: SKIPPED
      - name: RefinementTask
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: Unique task identifier
          - name: nodeTarget
            type: AuditTarget
            description: The hierarchy level of the node (QUIZ, KNOWLEDGE, TOPIC, MILESTONE, COURSE)
          - name: nodeId
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the target entity
          - name: nodeLabel
            type: String
            description: Human-readable label for display
          - name: diagnosisKind
            type: DiagnosisKind
            description: Which analyzer flagged the problem
          - name: priority
            type: int
            description: Priority rank (1 = highest)
          - name: status
            type: RefinementTaskStatus
            description: Current status
      - name: RefinementPlan
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: id
            type: String
            description: Unique plan identifier
          - name: sourceAuditId
            type: String
            description: ID of the AuditReport this plan was derived from
          - name: createdAt
            type: Instant
            description: When this plan was created
          - name: tasks
            type: List<RefinementTask>
            description: Prioritized list of refinement tasks
      - name: SuggestedLemma
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: lemma
            type: String
          - name: pos
            type: String
          - name: reason
            type: String
          - name: cocaRank
            type: Integer
          - name: lemmaCount
            type: Integer
            description: Observed lemma-count signal for the target level when available; null means unavailable.
          - name: lemmaCountThreshold
            type: Integer
            description: Minimum lemma-count threshold used to decide underexposure when available; null means unavailable.
          - name: isUnderexposed
            type: Boolean
            description: >-
              Whether lemmaCount is below lemmaCountThreshold when lemma-count data is available; null means
              unavailable.
      - name: SentenceLengthCorrectionContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: taskId
            type: String
          - name: sentence
            type: String
          - name: translation
            type: String
          - name: knowledgeTitle
            type: String
          - name: knowledgeInstructions
            type: String
          - name: topicLabel
            type: String
          - name: cefrLevel
            type: CefrLevel
          - name: tokenCount
            type: int
          - name: targetMin
            type: int
          - name: targetMax
            type: int
          - name: delta
            type: int
          - name: suggestedLemmas
            type: List<SuggestedLemma>
        implements:
          - CorrectionContext
      - name: MisplacedLemmaContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: lemma
            type: String
            description: Base form of the misplaced word
          - name: pos
            type: String
            description: Part of speech (e.g., VERB, NOUN)
          - name: expectedLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level where this word belongs per EVP (always higher than quizLevel)
          - name: quizLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level of the quiz where the word was found
          - name: cocaRank
            type: Integer
            description: COCA frequency ranking (nullable)
      - name: LemmaAbsenceCorrectionContext
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: taskId
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the refinement task
          - name: sentence
            type: String
            description: Current quiz sentence as plain text
          - name: translation
            type: String
            description: Spanish translation of the sentence
          - name: knowledgeTitle
            type: String
            description: Title of the parent knowledge
          - name: knowledgeInstructions
            type: String
            description: Instructions of the exercise
          - name: topicLabel
            type: String
            description: Label of the parent topic
          - name: cefrLevel
            type: CefrLevel
            description: CEFR level determined by milestone ancestor
          - name: misplacedLemmas
            type: List<MisplacedLemmaContext>
            description: Words in the quiz whose expected CEFR level is higher than the quiz level
          - name: suggestedLemmas
            type: List<SuggestedLemma>
            description: Absent lemmas from the level that could serve as replacements (reuses existing SuggestedLemma model)
          - name: quizSentence
            type: String
            description: >-
              FEAT-QSENT DSL of the original quiz (R001). Copied verbatim from AuditableQuiz.quizSentence by
              LemmaAbsenceContextResolver; never recomputed in this module. Coexists with `sentence` (plain) per R001 —
              both correspond to the same quiz and the same derivation step (R003). Null when the upstream AuditableQuiz
              was built before FEAT-QSENT was shipped.
          - name: tokenCount
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Cantidad actual de tokens en la oracion del quiz, copiada de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.tokenCount sobre el
              mismo nodo quiz (F-RCLALEN-R001, F-RCLALEN-R003). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico de longitud
              disponible (F-RCLALEN-R004); reusa nombre y semantica de F-RCSL-R001.
          - name: targetMin
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Minimo de tokens esperados para el nivel CEFR del quiz, copiado de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.targetMin
              (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004).
          - name: targetMax
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Maximo de tokens esperados para el nivel CEFR del quiz, copiado de SentenceLengthDiagnosis.targetMax
              (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004).
          - name: delta
            type: Integer
            description: >
              Desviacion respecto al rango: 0 si esta dentro, positivo si excede el maximo, negativo si esta por debajo
              del minimo (F-RCLALEN-R001). Nullable cuando no hay diagnostico (F-RCLALEN-R004). Misma convencion de
              signo que F-RCSL-R001.
          - name: lengthDirection
            type: LengthDirection
            description: >
              Direccion accionable derivada del signo de delta por el resolver (F-RCLALEN-R002). Cuando no hay
              SentenceLengthDiagnosis se establece a UNKNOWN (F-RCLALEN-R004), nunca null. Pre-calculado del lado del
              sistema para que el prompt LLM sea deterministico y la salida CLI tenga una etiqueta legible para humanos.
        implements:
          - CorrectionContext
      - name: LengthDirection
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: SHORTEN
            description: La oracion excede el rango (delta > 0); el LLM debe acortarla mientras reemplaza vocabulario.
          - name: LENGTHEN
            description: >-
              La oracion esta por debajo del rango (delta < 0); el LLM tiene margen para incorporar mas vocabulario
              sugerido.
          - name: KEEP_SAME
            description: La oracion esta dentro del rango (delta == 0); el LLM debe mantener una longitud similar al reemplazar.
          - name: UNKNOWN
            description: >-
              No hay SentenceLengthDiagnosis disponible para el nodo quiz (F-RCLALEN-R004); el LLM solo se gua por las
              reglas existentes de FEAT-RCLA.
        visibility: public
        glossarySuggestions:
          - name: Length Direction
            technicalName: LengthDirection
            kind: value-object-candidate
            basedOn: refiner-domain/LengthDirection
            rationale: >
              Etiqueta accionable y enumerable que el contexto de correccion expone al LLM. Si surge la necesidad de
              razonarla en otros contextos (revision, refinement, reportes), promover a termino canonico del glosario.

    scope: internal
  - name: audit-cli
    description: CLI entry point
    dependsOn:
      - audit-application
      - audit-domain
      - course-domain
      - course-infrastructure
      - nlp-infrastructure
      - vocabulary-infrastructure
      - audit-infrastructure
      - refiner-domain
      - revision-domain
      - revision-infrastructure
    models:
      - name: GetTasksFilter
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: planId
            type: Optional<String>
            description: Restrict to tasks belonging to this plan id; if empty, the most recent plan is used (R012)
          - name: status
            type: Optional<String>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose status matches this value, case-insensitive (pending/completed/skipped) — R008
          - name: sortByPriority
            type: boolean
            description: If true, order results by ascending task priority — R008
          - name: limit
            type: Optional<Integer>
            description: Cap the result count after filter+sort; 0 yields empty (R009); negative is rejected
          - name: target
            type: Optional<AuditTarget>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose nodeTarget matches this AuditTarget enum value; absent = no filter (R008)
          - name: diagnosisKind
            type: Optional<DiagnosisKind>
            description: Restrict to tasks whose diagnosisKind matches this DiagnosisKind enum value; absent = no filter (R008)
      - name: LagenMode
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: LLM
            description: Default. The CLI wires the LangChain4j-backed generator from revision-infrastructure (F-LAGEN-R013).
          - name: CANNED
            description: >-
              Opt-in offline mode. The CLI wires CannedLemmaAbsenceQuizCandidateGenerator from
              revision-domain.lemmaabsence with fixed quizSentence/translation. DOUBT-CANNED-MODE-AVAILABILITY -> Option
              B (kept as opt-in, never default).
        visibility: public
      - name: PlanStorageMode
        type: enum
        fields:
          - name: DISK
            description: >-
              Persistent path: el plan se guarda via RefinementPlanStore en .content-audit/refinement-plans/.
              Comportamiento previo a F-PLANEF, sigue siendo el default cuando el operador no pasa --storage.
          - name: EPHEMERAL
            description: >-
              Modo efimero (F-PLANEF-R001). El comando plan calcula el plan, NO lo persiste, y emite la representacion
              JSON completa por stdout. Mensajes informativos van a stderr.
        visibility: public
      - name: EphemeralRenderOptions
        type: record
        fields:
          - name: withCorrectionContext
            type: boolean
            description: >-
              F-PLANEF-R002: si true, cada task del plan emitido lleva inline su correctionContext (o
              correctionContext=null + correctionContextError si no es construible). Default OFF (DOUBT-CTX-DEFAULT
              opcion A).
        visibility: public
    interfaces:
      - name: AnalyzeCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: >-
              analyze(String coursePath, String format, String level, String topic, String knowledge, List<String>
              analyzers, boolean detailed): Integer
      - name: GetCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "get(String resource, String name, GetTasksFilter filter): Integer"
      - name: DeleteCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "delete(String resource, String id): Integer"
      - name: PruneCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "prune(String resource, int keep): Integer"
      - name: PlanCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "plan(String auditId, PlanStorageMode storageMode, boolean withCorrectionContext): Integer"
      - name: ReviseCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: false
        exposes:
          - signature: >-
              revise(String taskId, String planId, String correctionContextJson, String correctionContextFilePath):
              Integer
      - name: ConfigAnalyzerCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "showConfig(String analyzerName): Integer"
      - name: StatsAnalyzerCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "showStats(String analyzerName, String coursePath): Integer"
      - name: ApproveCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "approve(String resource, String proposalId, String planId, String note): Integer"
      - name: RejectCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "reject(String resource, String proposalId, String planId, String reason): Integer"
      - name: GetConsolidatedCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "getConsolidated(String coursePath, String format): Integer"
      - name: SetActiveAnalysisCommand
        stereotype: port
        sealed: true
        exposes:
          - signature: "setActive(String auditId, String planId): Integer"
    patterns:
      - type: Strategy
        implementations:
          - TextReportFormatter
          - JsonReportFormatter
          - TableReportFormatter
        suppressed: false
        interface: ReportFormatter
    scope: public
    packages:
      - name: commands
        description: Public CLI command tree — the only exported API of the audit-cli module
        visibility: internal
        interfaces:
          - name: EphemeralPlanRenderer
            stereotype: port

            exposes:
              - signature: "render(RefinementPlan plan, AuditReport report, EphemeralRenderOptions options): Integer"
            visibility: internal

              - signature: "toJsonMap(CorrectionContext context): Map<String,Object>"
            visibility: internal

          - name: DefaultEphemeralPlanRenderer
            requiresInject:
              - name: auditNodeIndexFactory
                type: AuditNodeIndexFactory
                description: Construye el indice del report una vez por invocacion del renderer cuando se pide contexto inline.
              - name: correctionContextResolver
                type: CorrectionContextResolver
                description: Inyectado en su forma dispatching; se llama via resolveWithIndex(index, report, task).
              - name: correctionContextJsonMapper
                type: CorrectionContextJsonMapper
                description: >-
                  Misma instancia que GetCmd usa, garantizando que el JSON emitido por plan efimero y por get task
                  tengan la misma forma.
            visibility: internal
            handwrittenTests:
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks no vacias, cuando render se invoca, entonces el JSON emitido tiene
                  las mismas claves top-level (id, sourceAuditId, createdAt, tasks) y dentro de cada task las mismas
                  claves (id, nodeTarget, nodeId, nodeLabel, diagnosisKind, priority, status) que el JSON producido por
                  FileSystemRefinementPlanStore.save sobre el mismo plan — R001 invariante 2: schema-equivalencia con el
                  plan persistido
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan, cuando render escribe a stdout y el JSON emitido se vuelve a deserializar con
                  el ObjectMapper estandar (JavaTimeModule), entonces el RefinementPlan deserializado es igual al
                  original (mismo id, sourceAuditId, createdAt y tasks) — R001 invariante 2: round-trip JSON, un cliente
                  que parsea planes persistidos parsea planes efimeros sin cambios
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan, cuando render se invoca, entonces el JSON se emite por la salida estandar
                  (stdout) y stderr permanece vacio — R001 invariante 2: el canal del plan es stdout, no stderr
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R001
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks no vacias y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=false,
                  cuando render se invoca, entonces el JSON emitido no contiene la clave correctionContext en ninguna
                  task y ni el resolver ni el mapper son invocados — R002 invariante #3: opt-in default OFF preserva
                  R001 y no se cambia silenciosamente
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando render se
                  invoca y el resolver retorna contexto para cada task, entonces cada task del JSON emitido tiene un
                  campo correctionContext igual al mapa producido por CorrectionContextJsonMapper.toJsonMap aplicado al
                  contexto resuelto via resolveWithIndex con el indice construido a partir del AuditReport — R002
                  invariante #1: contexto inline por tarea con la misma estructura/semantica que get task
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan y una unica instancia de CorrectionContextJsonMapper inyectada en GetCmd y en
                  DefaultEphemeralPlanRenderer, cuando ambos comandos serializan el correctionContext de la misma task
                  derivada del mismo AuditReport, entonces el campo correctionContext que emite plan efimero es
                  estructuralmente igual al que emite get task (mismas claves, mismos valores) — R002 invariante #2:
                  equivalencia funcional con get task garantizada por compartir el mapper
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando render se
                  invoca y el resolver retorna Optional.empty para una task (contexto no construible), entonces esa task
                  del JSON emitido tiene correctionContext en null y un campo descriptivo del motivo, con la misma
                  semantica que F-RCLA-R008 define para get task — R002 invariante #4: tareas sin contexto construible
                  llevan correctionContext ausente o nulo + motivo
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
              - name: >-
                  Dado un RefinementPlan con tasks mixtas y EphemeralRenderOptions.withCorrectionContext=true, cuando
                  render se invoca y el resolver retorna contexto para algunas tasks y Optional.empty para otras,
                  entonces el comando retorna codigo 0, el JSON emitido contiene todas las tasks, las tasks resueltas
                  llevan correctionContext con valor y las no resueltas llevan correctionContext en null + motivo — R002
                  invariante #4: el comando no falla globalmente, emite el plan completo con la falla por tarea visible
                  para el cliente
                traceability:
                  feature: FEAT-PLANEF
                  rule: F-PLANEF-R002
            implements:
              - EphemeralPlanRenderer
          - name: DefaultCorrectionContextJsonMapper
            visibility: internal
            implements:
              - CorrectionContextJsonMapper

                type: Optional<String>
                description: Selected topic within the level
              - name: knowledge

      - name: bootstrap
        description: >-
